theorem locallyMinimizing_affine_density_iff {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (a b : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) θ ℓ ↔
      LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have he (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
      (h0 : ψ 0 = θ 0) (hend : ψ ℓ = θ ℓ) :
      energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) θ ℓ ≤
          energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) ψ ℓ ↔
        energy ε θ ℓ ≤ energy ε ψ ℓ := by
    rw [energy_affine_density hε hθ, energy_affine_density hε hψ, h0, hend]
    exact (add_le_add_iff_right _).trans (add_le_add_iff_right _)
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨r, hr, hm⟩ <;> refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩ <;>
    intro ψ hψ h0 hend hx hy hclose
  · exact (he ψ hψ h0 hend).mp (hm ψ hψ h0 hend hx hy hclose)
  · exact (he ψ hψ h0 hend).mpr (hm ψ hψ h0 hend hx hy hclose)
records.comment:
Adding an affine function of signed curvature preserves the same C¹
constrained local minima, including the same neighborhood radius.

records.proof:
by
  have he (η : variationSpace ℓ) :
      (fun t => energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) (angleVariation θ η.val t) ℓ) =
        (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η.val t) ℓ +
          (a * (θ ℓ - θ 0) + b * ℓ)) := by
    funext t
    have hvar : ContDiff ℝ 1 (angleVariation θ η.val t) :=
      hθ.add (contDiff_const.mul η.property.1)
    rw [energy_affine_density hε hvar]
    simp only [angleVariation, η.property.2.1, η.property.2.2, mul_zero, add_zero]
    ring
  unfold Stationary
  simp_rw [he, deriv_add_const]

theorem locallyMinimizing_powerLogDensity_one_iff {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ κ₀ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (K : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) :
    LocallyMinimizing (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ ↔
      LocallyMinimizing (fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have he : powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀ =
      fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2 + (-K) * q + K * κ₀ / 2 := by
    funext q
    rw [powerLogDensity_one K hκ₀]
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact locallyMinimizing_affine_density_iff (by fun_prop) hθ (-K) (K * κ₀ / 2)
records.comment:
Exponent one gives exactly the classical quadratic C¹ local-minimum
problem, on all signed curvatures and with the original endpoint constraints.

theorem stationary_powerLogDensity_one_iff {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ κ₀ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (K : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) :
    Stationary (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ ↔
      Stationary (fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have he : powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀ =
      fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2 + (-K) * q + K * κ₀ / 2 := by
    funext q
    rw [powerLogDensity_one K hκ₀]
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact stationary_affine_density_iff (by fun_prop) hθ (-K) (K * κ₀ / 2)
records.comment:
The exponent-one response and the corresponding quadratic density have
the same stationary angles under the original linearized endpoint constraints.

theorem locallyMinimizing_powerLogDensity_one_classical_equations
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ κ₀ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0) (K : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      ((K / κ₀) * deriv (deriv θ) s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
      ((K / κ₀) * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / 2 -
        lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      ((K / κ₀) * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s +
        (K / κ₀) * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 - σ * deriv θ s = 0)
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv θ) := hθ.deriv' (n := 2)
  have hmin' := (locallyMinimizing_powerLogDensity_one_iff hθ1 K hκ₀).mp hmin
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, σ, heq⟩ :=
    locallyMinimizing_angle_firstIntegral_curvature hℓ (by fun_prop) hθ hne hmin'
  have hmoment : (fun t => deriv (fun q : ℝ => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) (deriv θ t)) =
      (fun t => (K / κ₀) * deriv θ t) := by
    funext t
    exact (quadratic_density_hasDerivAt (K / κ₀) (deriv θ t)).deriv
  refine ⟨lam, μ, σ, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hangle, hfirst, hcurve⟩ := heq s hs
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, quadratic_curvature_equation hκ hcurve⟩
  · rw [hmoment] at hangle
    rw [((hκ.differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (K / κ₀)).deriv]
      at hangle
    exact hangle
  · rw [(quadratic_density_hasDerivAt (K / κ₀) (deriv θ s)).deriv] at hfirst
    nlinarith [hfirst]
records.comment:
A nonstraight C³ local minimum for the exponent-one response satisfies the
classical angle, first-integral, and curvature equations with stiffness `K / κ₀`.
The hypotheses are on the actual constrained energy; no stationarity or equation
is supplied.  The first-integral constant is that of the quadratic representative.

theorem locallyMinimizing_powerLogDensity_one_scaling_iff {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a ℓ κ₀ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (K : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) :
    LocallyMinimizing (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) ↔
      LocallyMinimizing (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  exact (locallyMinimizing_powerLogDensity_one_iff (contDiff_angle_scaling hθ a) K hκ₀).trans
    ((locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_quadratic ha hθ (K / κ₀)).trans
      (locallyMinimizing_powerLogDensity_one_iff hθ K hκ₀).symm)
records.comment:
Fixed K and reference curvature still give equivalent C¹ local-minimum
problems under similarity, even though this density itself is not homogeneous.

records.statement:
theorem energy_powerLogDensity_one_scaling {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a κ₀ : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (K : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      energy (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ / a +
      K * (1 / a - 1) * (θ ℓ - θ 0) + K * κ₀ / 2 * (a - 1 / a) * ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_powerLogDensity_one (contDiff_angle_scaling hθ a) K hκ₀,
    energy_scaling_quadratic (hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero) ha,
    energy_powerLogDensity_one hθ K hκ₀]
  simp only [zero_div, mul_div_cancel_left₀ ℓ ha.ne']
  ring
records.comment:
The exact scaling law includes boundary constants. It is not the
homogeneous scaling law of the quadratic representative alone.

theorem integral_split_three {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (a b ℓ : ℝ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, f s) =
      (∫ s in 0..a, f s) + (∫ s in a..b, f s) + (∫ s in b..ℓ, f s)
records.proof:
by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 a) (hf.intervalIntegrable a b),
    intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 b) (hf.intervalIntegrable b ℓ)]
records.comment:
Three consecutive oriented interval integrals give the original integral.
In applications the cuts satisfy `0 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ ℓ`; the identity itself needs no
ordering assumption.

theorem energy_split_three {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (a b ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ =
      (∫ s in 0..a, ε (deriv θ s)) +
      (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s)) +
      (∫ s in b..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s))
records.proof: integral_split_three (hε.comp hθ.continuous_deriv_one) a b ℓ
records.comment: The actual curvature energy splits into the three pieces.

theorem xCoord_sub_eq_integral {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (x₀ a b : ℝ) :
    xCoord θ x₀ b - xCoord θ x₀ a = ∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)
records.proof:
by
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    (μ := volume) (f := fun s => cos (θ s))
    ((continuous_cos.comp hθ).intervalIntegrable 0 a)
    ((continuous_cos.comp hθ).intervalIntegrable a b)
  unfold xCoord
  linarith
records.comment: The horizontal displacement of any subarc is its tangent integral.

theorem yCoord_sub_eq_integral {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (y₀ a b : ℝ) :
    yCoord θ y₀ b - yCoord θ y₀ a = ∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)
records.proof:
by
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    (μ := volume) (f := fun s => sin (θ s))
    ((continuous_sin.comp hθ).intervalIntegrable 0 a)
    ((continuous_sin.comp hθ).intervalIntegrable a b)
  unfold yCoord
  linarith
records.comment: The vertical displacement of any subarc is its tangent integral.

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_split_three {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (x₀ a b ℓ : ℝ) :
    xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ +
      ((∫ s in 0..a, cos (θ s)) + (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) +
        (∫ s in b..ℓ, cos (θ s)))
records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord
  exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ => x₀ + z)
    (integral_split_three (f := fun s => cos (θ s)) (continuous_cos.comp hθ) a b ℓ)
records.comment: Position reconstruction splits at exactly the same cut locations as energy.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_split_three {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (y₀ a b ℓ : ℝ) :
    yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = y₀ +
      ((∫ s in 0..a, sin (θ s)) + (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) +
        (∫ s in b..ℓ, sin (θ s)))
records.proof:
by
  unfold yCoord
  exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ => y₀ + z)
    (integral_split_three (f := fun s => sin (θ s)) (continuous_sin.comp hθ) a b ℓ)

theorem density_integral_eq_of_angle_eqOn {ε θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hEq : EqOn θ φ (Icc a b)) :
    (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)
records.proof:
by
  rcases hab.eq_or_lt with hab | hab
  · subst b
    simp
  have hd : EqOn (deriv θ) (deriv φ) (Ioo a b) := by
    intro s hs
    have he : θ =ᶠ[𝓝 s] φ := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with t ht
      exact hEq ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩
    exact he.deriv_eq
  have hdc : EqOn (deriv θ) (deriv φ) (Icc a b) := by
    have hc := hd.closure hθ.continuous_deriv_one hφ.continuous_deriv_one
    simpa only [closure_Ioo hab.ne] using hc
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s hs
  rw [uIcc_of_le hab.le] at hs
  exact congrArg ε (hdc hs)
records.comment:
Agreement of two C¹ angles on a closed interval implies agreement of
their density integrals. Derivative agreement is derived, not assumed.
Degenerate intervals are included.

theorem boundary_eq_of_middle_integrals {θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hφ : Continuous φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (_hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ))
    (hx : (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s))
    (hy : (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s))
    (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    θ 0 = φ 0 ∧ θ ℓ = φ ℓ ∧
      xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = xCoord φ x₀ ℓ ∧ yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = yCoord φ y₀ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have hcos_left : (∫ s in 0..a, cos (θ s)) = ∫ s in 0..a, cos (φ s) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le ha] at hs
    exact congrArg cos (hleft hs)
  have hsin_left : (∫ s in 0..a, sin (θ s)) = ∫ s in 0..a, sin (φ s) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le ha] at hs
    exact congrArg sin (hleft hs)
  have hcos_right : (∫ s in b..ℓ, cos (θ s)) = ∫ s in b..ℓ, cos (φ s) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le hb] at hs
    exact congrArg cos (hright hs)
  have hsin_right : (∫ s in b..ℓ, sin (θ s)) = ∫ s in b..ℓ, sin (φ s) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le hb] at hs
    exact congrArg sin (hright hs)
  refine ⟨hleft ⟨le_rfl, ha⟩, hright ⟨hb, le_rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [xCoord_split_three hθ x₀ a b ℓ, xCoord_split_three hφ x₀ a b ℓ,
      hcos_left, hx, hcos_right]
  · rw [yCoord_split_three hθ y₀ a b ℓ, yCoord_split_three hφ y₀ a b ℓ,
      hsin_left, hy, hsin_right]
records.comment:
Two already smooth curves with the same exterior angles have the same
boundary angles and positions when both middle displacement integrals match.
The theorem does not construct a gluing from arbitrary angle pieces.

records.statement:
theorem energy_sub_eq_middle_of_outer_angle_eq {ε θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (_hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ)) :
    energy ε φ ℓ - energy ε θ ℓ =
      (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) - (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s))
records.proof:
by
  have hl := density_integral_eq_of_angle_eqOn (ε := ε) hθ hφ ha hleft
  have hr := density_integral_eq_of_angle_eqOn (ε := ε) hθ hφ hb hright
  rw [energy_split_three hε hθ a b ℓ, energy_split_three hε hφ a b ℓ, hl, hr]
  ring
records.comment:
A smooth middle replacement changes the total energy by exactly the middle
integral difference. The angle agreement outside implies derivative agreement.

records.statement:
theorem energy_le_iff_middle_integral_le {ε θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ)) :
    energy ε φ ℓ ≤ energy ε θ ℓ ↔
      (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) ≤ ∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s)
records.proof:
by
  have h := energy_sub_eq_middle_of_outer_angle_eq hε hθ hφ ha hab hb hleft hright
  constructor <;> intro hh <;> linarith
records.comment:
Under the same smooth exterior data, energy comparison is exactly comparison
of the middle integrals. No minimizer existence is asserted.

theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_integral_variation {ε κ v : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hv : Continuous v) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (κ s + t * v s)))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (κ s) * (v s) ^ 2) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd : deriv (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (κ s + t * v s)) =
      fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s := by
    funext t
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      (hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (w := fun _ => 1) hℓ
        (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hκ hv continuous_const t).deriv
  rw [hd]
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero, mul_assoc, ← pow_two] using
    (hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (ε := deriv ε) (w := v)
      hℓ hε.deriv' hκ hv hv 0)
records.comment:
Second parameter derivative for the actual integral, without imposing that
the argument of the density is a spatial derivative.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_add {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {f₂ g₂ x : ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 x, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t)
    (hg : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 x, DifferentiableAt ℝ g t)
    (hf₂ : HasDerivAt (deriv f) f₂ x) (hg₂ : HasDerivAt (deriv g) g₂ x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => f t + g t)) (f₂ + g₂) x
records.proof:
by
  apply (hf₂.add hg₂).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [hf, hg] with t hft hgt
  exact deriv_add hft hgt
records.comment: Differentiating a sum twice when the first derivatives exist in a neighborhood.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_const_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {f₂ x : ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 x, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t)
    (hf₂ : HasDerivAt (deriv f) f₂ x) (a : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => a * f t)) (a * f₂) x
records.proof:
by
  apply (hf₂.const_mul a).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [hf] with t hft
  exact deriv_const_mul a hft
records.comment: Constant multiplication commutes with the second derivative.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_augmentedEnergy_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (lam μ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => augmentedEnergy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ lam μ))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s) ^ 2 -
        (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η s) ^ 2) 0
records.proof:
by
  let f := fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ
  let g := fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η s)
  let h := fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η s)
  have hf (t : ℝ) : DifferentiableAt ℝ f t :=
    (hasDerivAt_energy_variation_at hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ hη t).differentiableAt
  have hg (t : ℝ) : DifferentiableAt ℝ g t := by
    have hg' := hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (ε := cos) (w := fun _ => 1)
      hℓ contDiff_cos hθ.continuous hη.continuous continuous_const t
    simpa only [mul_one] using hg'.differentiableAt
  have hh (t : ℝ) : DifferentiableAt ℝ h t := by
    have hh' := hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (ε := sin) (w := fun _ => 1)
      hℓ contDiff_sin hθ.continuous hη.continuous continuous_const t
    simpa only [mul_one] using hh'.differentiableAt
  have hf₂ := hasDerivAt_deriv_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη
  have hg₂ : HasDerivAt (deriv g) (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -cos (θ s) * (η s)^2) 0 := by
    simpa only [Real.deriv_cos', deriv.fun_neg, Real.deriv_sin] using
      (hasDerivAt_deriv_integral_variation hℓ (ε := cos) contDiff_cos hθ.continuous hη.continuous)
  have hh₂ : HasDerivAt (deriv h) (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * (η s)^2) 0 := by
    simpa only [Real.deriv_sin, Real.deriv_cos] using
      (hasDerivAt_deriv_integral_variation hℓ (ε := sin) contDiff_sin hθ.continuous hη.continuous)
  have hsum := hasDerivAt_deriv_add
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => (hf t).add ((hg t).const_mul lam)))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => (hh t).const_mul μ))
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_add (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hf)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => (hg t).const_mul lam)) hf₂
      (hasDerivAt_deriv_const_mul (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg) hg₂ lam))
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_const_mul (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hh) hh₂ μ)
  have hε₂ : Continuous (deriv (deriv ε)) := hε.deriv'.continuous_deriv_one
  have hi₁ : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun s => deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2) volume 0 ℓ :=
    ((hε₂.comp hθ.continuous_deriv_one).mul (hη.continuous_deriv_one.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  have hi₂ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => lam * (-cos (θ s) * (η s)^2)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul ((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ.continuous).neg.mul
      (hη.continuous.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  have hi₃ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => μ * (-sin (θ s) * (η s)^2)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul ((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ.continuous).neg.mul
      (hη.continuous.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  have heq : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2) +
      lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -cos (θ s) * (η s)^2) +
      μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * (η s)^2) =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2 -
        (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η s)^2 := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add hi₁ hi₂,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add (hi₁.add hi₂) hi₃]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    dsimp
    ring
  rw [heq] at hsum
  exact hsum
records.comment: The actual additive second variation of the Lagrange augmented energy.

records.statement:
theorem secondVariation_augmentedEnergy {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (lam μ : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (fun t => augmentedEnergy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ lam μ)) 0 =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2 -
        (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η s)^2
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_deriv_augmentedEnergy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη lam μ).deriv
records.comment: Scalar second derivative form of the augmented variation theorem.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_of_continuousOn_rectangle
    {F D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ r t₀ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Ioo (-r) r)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) (Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc 0 ℓ))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => D p.1 p.2) (Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc 0 ℓ))
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun u => F u s) (D t s) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, F t s) (∫ s in 0..ℓ, D t₀ s) t₀
records.proof:
by
  have hint (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (-r) r) : IntervalIntegrable (F t) volume 0 ℓ := by
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hℓ
    exact hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨ht, hs⟩)
  have hdint (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (-r) r) : IntervalIntegrable (D t) volume 0 ℓ := by
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hℓ
    exact hD.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨ht, hs⟩)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (-r) r)).prod
      (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hD
  have hmeas : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, AEStronglyMeasurable (F t) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds ht₀.1 ht₀.2] with t ht
    exact (hint t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩).1.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ),
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r, ‖D t s‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with s hs
    intro t ht
    exact hC (t, s) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩, ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ), ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r,
      HasDerivAt (fun u => F u s) (D t s) t := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with s hs
    exact fun t ht => hd t ht s ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (Ioo_mem_nhds ht₀.1 ht₀.2) hmeas (hint t₀ ⟨ht₀.1.le, ht₀.2.le⟩).1
    (hdint t₀ ⟨ht₀.1.le, ht₀.2.le⟩).1.aestronglyMeasurable hbound (integrable_const C) hdiff
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hℓ] using h.2
records.comment:
Local differentiation under a finite integral. The hypotheses concern the
integrand and its actual pointwise derivative, not the integral derivative.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_integral_of_continuousOn_rectangle
    {F D D₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ r : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) (Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc 0 ℓ))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => D p.1 p.2) (Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc 0 ℓ))
    (hD₂ : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => D₂ p.1 p.2) (Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc 0 ℓ))
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun u => F u s) (D t s) t)
    (hd₂ : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun u => D u s) (D₂ t s) t) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, F t s)) (∫ s in 0..ℓ, D₂ 0 s) 0
records.proof:
by
  have ht : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-r) r := ⟨by linarith, hr⟩
  apply (hasDerivAt_integral_of_continuousOn_rectangle hℓ ht hD hD₂ hd₂).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2] with t ht'
  exact (hasDerivAt_integral_of_continuousOn_rectangle hℓ ht' hF hD hd).deriv
records.comment: Local second differentiation under the actual integral.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_density_integral
    {ε : ℝ → ℝ} {K V A : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ r : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hr : 0 < r) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hK : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => K p.1 p.2) (Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc 0 ℓ))
    (hV : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => V p.1 p.2) (Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc 0 ℓ))
    (hA : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => A p.1 p.2) (Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc 0 ℓ))
    (hKV : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun u => K u s) (V t s) t)
    (hVA : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun u => V u s) (A t s) t) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (K t s)))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (K 0 s) * (V 0 s)^2 + deriv ε (K 0 s) * A 0 s) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hε₁ : Continuous (deriv ε) := hε.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)
  have hε₂ : Continuous (deriv (deriv ε)) := hε.deriv'.continuous_deriv_one
  refine hasDerivAt_deriv_integral_of_continuousOn_rectangle
    (F := fun t s => ε (K t s)) (D := fun t s => deriv ε (K t s) * V t s)
    (D₂ := fun t s => deriv (deriv ε) (K t s) * (V t s)^2 + deriv ε (K t s) * A t s) hℓ hr
    (hε.continuous.comp_continuousOn hK)
    ((hε₁.comp_continuousOn hK).mul hV)
    (((hε₂.comp_continuousOn hK).mul (hV.pow 2)).add
      ((hε₁.comp_continuousOn hK).mul hA)) ?_ ?_
  · intro t ht s hs
    exact ((hε.differentiable (by norm_num)) (K t s)).hasDerivAt.comp t (hKV t ht s hs)
  · intro t ht s hs
    convert (((hε.deriv'.differentiable one_ne_zero) (K t s)).hasDerivAt.comp t
      (hKV t ht s hs)).mul (hVA t ht s hs) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [Function.comp_apply]; ring)
records.comment: Chain and product rules under the integral, with actual pointwise time jets.

records.proof:
by
  have he := (ha.eventually (by norm_num)).and (hb.eventually (by norm_num))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp he
  refine ⟨δ / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  apply hsub
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
records.comment:
Local C² correction coefficients have a common compact time neighborhood
on which their first two derivatives are continuous and their jets exist.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_corrected_integral_and_deriv
    {ε κ v u w a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hκ : Continuous κ) (hv : Continuous v) (hu : Continuous u) (hw : Continuous w)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (κ s + t * v s + a t * u s + b t * w s))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (κ s) * v s) 0 ∧
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      ε (κ s + t * v s + a t * u s + b t * w s)))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (κ s) * (v s)^2 +
        deriv ε (κ s) * (deriv (deriv a) 0 * u s + deriv (deriv b) 0 * w s)) 0
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hab⟩ := exists_correction_radius ha hb
  have ca : ContinuousOn a (Icc (-r) r) := fun t ht => (hab t ht).1.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have cb : ContinuousOn b (Icc (-r) r) := fun t ht => (hab t ht).2.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have ca1 : ContinuousOn (deriv a) (Icc (-r) r) := fun t ht =>
    ((hab t ht).1.derivWithin (m := 1) (by norm_num)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have cb1 : ContinuousOn (deriv b) (Icc (-r) r) := fun t ht =>
    ((hab t ht).2.derivWithin (m := 1) (by norm_num)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have ca2 : ContinuousOn (deriv (deriv a)) (Icc (-r) r) := fun t ht =>
    (((hab t ht).1.derivWithin (m := 1) (by norm_num)).derivWithin
      (m := 0) (by norm_num)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have cb2 : ContinuousOn (deriv (deriv b)) (Icc (-r) r) := fun t ht =>
    (((hab t ht).2.derivWithin (m := 1) (by norm_num)).derivWithin
      (m := 0) (by norm_num)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  let S := Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ
  have cp {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-r) r)) :
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => f p.1) S :=
    hf.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun _ hp => hp.1)
  have cs {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) :
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => f p.2) S := (hf.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
  let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun t s => κ s + t * v s + a t * u s + b t * w s
  let V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun t s => v s + deriv a t * u s + deriv b t * w s
  let A : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun t s => deriv (deriv a) t * u s + deriv (deriv b) t * w s
  have hK : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => K p.1 p.2) S :=
    (((cs hκ).add (continuous_fst.continuousOn.mul (cs hv))).add
      ((cp ca).mul (cs hu))).add ((cp cb).mul (cs hw))
  have hV : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => V p.1 p.2) S :=
    ((cs hv).add ((cp ca1).mul (cs hu))).add ((cp cb1).mul (cs hw))
  have hA : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => A p.1 p.2) S :=
    ((cp ca2).mul (cs hu)).add ((cp cb2).mul (cs hw))
  have hdK : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => K t s) (V t s) t := by
    intro t ht s _
    have ha' := ((hab t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩).1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
    have hb' := ((hab t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩).2.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (v s)).const_add (κ s)).add
      (ha'.mul_const (u s))).add (hb'.mul_const (w s)) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | simp [V]
  have hdV : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-r) r, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => V t s) (A t s) t := by
    intro t ht s _
    have ha' := (((hab t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩).1.derivWithin
      (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero).hasDerivAt
    have hb' := (((hab t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩).2.derivWithin
      (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero).hasDerivAt
    convert ((ha'.mul_const (u s)).const_add (v s)).add (hb'.mul_const (w s)) using 1
  constructor
  · have hf := hasDerivAt_integral_of_continuousOn_rectangle
      (F := fun t s => ε (K t s)) (D := fun t s => deriv ε (K t s) * V t s)
      hℓ (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-r) r from ⟨by linarith, hr⟩)
      (hε.continuous.comp_continuousOn hK)
      (((hε.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)).comp_continuousOn hK).mul hV)
      (fun t ht s hs => ((hε.differentiable (by norm_num)) (K t s)).hasDerivAt.comp t
        (hdK t ht s hs))
    simpa [K, V, ha0, hb0, ha1, hb1] using hf
  · simpa [K, V, A, ha0, hb0, ha1, hb1] using
      (hasDerivAt_deriv_density_integral hℓ hr hε hK hV hA hdK hdV)
records.comment:
Exact second derivative of a locally C² corrected integral family. The
acceleration terms are derived, not discarded or assumed to vanish.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_corrected_integral
    {ε κ v u w a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hκ : Continuous κ) (hv : Continuous v) (hu : Continuous u) (hw : Continuous w)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      ε (κ s + t * v s + a t * u s + b t * w s)))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (κ s) * (v s)^2 +
        deriv ε (κ s) * (deriv (deriv a) 0 * u s + deriv (deriv b) 0 * w s)) 0
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_corrected_integral_and_deriv hℓ hε hκ hv hu hw ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).2
records.comment: Second derivative projection of the full corrected integral calculation.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_corrected_angle {θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) (hη : Differentiable ℝ η)
    (hξ₁ : Differentiable ℝ ξ₁) (hξ₂ : Differentiable ℝ ξ₂)
    (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (t s : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun x => θ x + t * η x + a t * ξ₁ x + b t * ξ₂ x) s =
      deriv θ s + t * deriv η s + a t * deriv ξ₁ s + b t * deriv ξ₂ s
records.proof:
by
  exact ((((hθ s).hasDerivAt.add ((hη s).hasDerivAt.const_mul t)).add
    ((hξ₁ s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (a t))).add ((hξ₂ s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (b t))).deriv
records.comment: Spatial differentiation of the actual corrected angle family.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_and_deriv
    {ε θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η)
    (hξ₁ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ξ₁) (hξ₂ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ξ₂)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => energy ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁ s + b t * ξ₂ s) ℓ)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s) 0 ∧
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => energy ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁ s + b t * ξ₂ s) ℓ))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2 +
        deriv ε (deriv θ s) *
          (deriv (deriv a) 0 * deriv ξ₁ s + deriv (deriv b) 0 * deriv ξ₂ s)) 0
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [energy, deriv_corrected_angle (hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero)
    (hη.differentiable one_ne_zero) (hξ₁.differentiable one_ne_zero) (hξ₂.differentiable one_ne_zero)]
    using hasDerivAt_corrected_integral_and_deriv hℓ hε hθ.continuous_deriv_one
      hη.continuous_deriv_one hξ₁.continuous_deriv_one hξ₂.continuous_deriv_one
      ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1
records.comment:
First and second derivatives of the actual energy along a locally C²
corrected angle family. The second derivative retains its acceleration term.

records.statement:
theorem second_deriv_zero_of_eventually_const {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c x : ℝ}
    (h : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => c) : deriv (deriv f) x = 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [h.deriv.deriv_eq]
  simp
records.comment: A function that is locally constant has zero actual second derivative.

records.statement:
theorem constrained_secondVariation_corrected
    {ε θ η a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ lam μ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η)
    (ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0)
    (hx : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      cos (θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s))
    (hy : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      sin (θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))
    (hstat : ∀ ζ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => energy ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2 -
        (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η s)^2) 0
records.proof:
by
  let ζ : variationSpace ℓ := ⟨fun s =>
      deriv (deriv a) 0 * ξ₁.val s + deriv (deriv b) 0 * ξ₂.val s,
    ⟨(contDiff_const.mul ξ₁.property.1).add (contDiff_const.mul ξ₂.property.1),
      by simp [ξ₁.property.2.1, ξ₂.property.2.1],
      by simp [ξ₁.property.2.2, ξ₂.property.2.2]⟩⟩
  have hdζ (s : ℝ) : deriv ζ.val s =
      deriv (deriv a) 0 * deriv ξ₁.val s + deriv (deriv b) 0 * deriv ξ₂.val s :=
    (((ξ₁.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (deriv (deriv a) 0)).add
      ((ξ₂.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (deriv (deriv b) 0))).deriv
  have he := (hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_and_deriv hℓ hε hθ hη ξ₁.property.1 ξ₂.property.1
    ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).2
  simp_rw [← hdζ] at he
  have hx₂ := (hasDerivAt_deriv_corrected_integral (ε := cos) hℓ contDiff_cos
    hθ.continuous hη.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous
    ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).deriv
  have hy₂ := (hasDerivAt_deriv_corrected_integral (ε := sin) hℓ contDiff_sin
    hθ.continuous hη.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous
    ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).deriv
  simp only [Real.deriv_cos', deriv.fun_neg, Real.deriv_sin] at hx₂
  simp only [Real.deriv_sin, Real.deriv_cos] at hy₂
  have hxI := hx₂.symm.trans (second_deriv_zero_of_eventually_const hx)
  have hyI := hy₂.symm.trans (second_deriv_zero_of_eventually_const hy)
  change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -cos (θ s) * (η s)^2 + -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0 at hxI
  change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * (η s)^2 + cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0 at hyI
  have hM : Continuous (fun s => deriv ε (deriv θ s)) :=
    (hε.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)).comp hθ.continuous_deriv_one
  have hE : Continuous (fun s => deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2) :=
    (hε.deriv'.continuous_deriv_one.comp hθ.continuous_deriv_one).mul
      (hη.continuous_deriv_one.pow 2)
  have hC : Continuous (fun s => -cos (θ s) * (η s)^2) :=
    (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ.continuous).neg.mul (hη.continuous.pow 2)
  have hS : Continuous (fun s => -sin (θ s) * (η s)^2) :=
    (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ.continuous).neg.mul (hη.continuous.pow 2)
  have hX : Continuous (fun s => -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) :=
    (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ.continuous).neg.mul ζ.property.1.continuous
  have hY : Continuous (fun s => cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) :=
    (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ.continuous).mul ζ.property.1.continuous
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hC.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) (hX.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)] at hxI
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hS.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) (hY.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)] at hyI
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
    (f := fun s => deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2)
    (g := fun s => deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s)
    (hE.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
    ((hM.mul ζ.property.1.continuous_deriv_one).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)] at he
  have hs := hstat ζ
  have heq : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2) +
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2 -
        (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η s)^2 := by
    calc
      _ = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2) +
          lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -cos (θ s) * (η s)^2) +
          μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * (η s)^2) := by
        nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => lam * x) hxI, congrArg (fun x : ℝ => μ * x) hyI]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
          ← intervalIntegral.integral_add
            (f := fun s => deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2)
            (g := fun s => lam * (-cos (θ s) * (η s)^2)) (hE.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
            ((continuous_const.mul hC).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ),
          ← intervalIntegral.integral_add
            (f := fun s => deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2 +
              lam * (-cos (θ s) * (η s)^2))
            (g := fun s => μ * (-sin (θ s) * (η s)^2))
            ((hE.add (continuous_const.mul hC)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
            ((continuous_const.mul hS).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)]
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s _
        dsimp
        ring
  rw [heq] at he
  exact he
records.comment:
Exact endpoint constraints and augmented stationarity cancel the acceleration
of a corrected family. The remaining value is the constrained second variation.

records.statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_curvature_of_nonconstant {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0) :
    ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0
records.proof:
by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hne
  exact angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial (θ := fun _ => θ 0) (ψ := θ)
    hℓ contDiff_const hθ (by simpa [curvature] using h) rfl
records.comment:
A C¹ angle which is not constant on the curve has nonzero curvature somewhere
in its interior.

records.statement:
theorem constraint_coefficients_zero {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ a b : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      a * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
      b * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0
records.proof:
by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => -a * sin (θ s) + b * cos (θ s)
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q := (contDiff_const.mul hθ.sin).add
    (contDiff_const.mul hθ.cos)
  let η : variationSpace ℓ := ⟨fun s => s * (ℓ - s) * q s,
    ⟨(contDiff_id.mul (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)).mul hq, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
  have hz : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, s * (ℓ - s) * (q s) ^ 2) = 0 := by
    have hh := h η
    rw [← force_integral hθ.continuous η] at hh
    convert hh using 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    change s * (ℓ - s) * (q s) ^ 2 = q s * (s * (ℓ - s) * q s)
    ring
  have hzero := residual_zero_of_weighted_square_integral hℓ hq.continuous hz
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hκ⟩ := hne
  have heq : q =ᶠ[nhds s] fun _ => 0 := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with t ht using hzero t ht
  have hd0 : HasDerivAt q 0 s := (hasDerivAt_const s (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  have hd : HasDerivAt q
      ((-a * cos (θ s) - b * sin (θ s)) * deriv θ s) s := by
    convert (((hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.sin.const_mul (-a)).add
      ((hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.cos.const_mul b)) using 1
    ring
  have hcoef : -a * cos (θ s) - b * sin (θ s) = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp (hd.unique hd0)).resolve_right hκ
  have hv : -a * sin (θ s) + b * cos (θ s) = 0 := hzero s hs
  have htrig := sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ s)
  constructor
  · calc
      a = a * ((sin (θ s)) ^ 2 + (cos (θ s)) ^ 2) := by rw [htrig, mul_one]
      _ = -sin (θ s) * (-a * sin (θ s) + b * cos (θ s)) -
          cos (θ s) * (-a * cos (θ s) - b * sin (θ s)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hv, hcoef]; ring
  · calc
      b = b * ((sin (θ s)) ^ 2 + (cos (θ s)) ^ 2) := by rw [htrig, mul_one]
      _ = cos (θ s) * (-a * sin (θ s) + b * cos (θ s)) -
          sin (θ s) * (-a * cos (θ s) - b * sin (θ s)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hv, hcoef]; ring
records.comment:
The endpoint-displacement differentials are independent on fixed-end
variations whenever the curve is not straight.

records.statement:
theorem exists_normalized_constraint_directions {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ξ₁.val s) = 1 ∧
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ξ₁.val s) = 0 ∧
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ξ₂.val s) = 0 ∧
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ξ₂.val s) = 1
records.proof:
by
  let cx := constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => -sin (θ s))
    (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ.continuous).neg
  let cy := constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => cos (θ s))
    (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ.continuous)
  let c : variationSpace ℓ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := cx.prod cy
  have hev (f : (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (x y : ℝ) :
      f (x, y) = f (1, 0) * x + f (0, 1) * y := by
    have hp : (x, y) = x • (1, 0) + y • (0, 1) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [hp, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have ha : (LinearMap.range c).dualAnnihilator = ⊥ := by
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    intro f hf
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator] at hf
    have hab : f (1, 0) = 0 ∧ f (0, 1) = 0 := by
      apply constraint_coefficients_zero hℓ hθ hne
      intro η
      have hfc : f (c η) = 0 := hf (c η) ⟨η, rfl⟩
      change f (cx η, cy η) = 0 at hfc
      rw [hev] at hfc
      exact hfc
    change f = 0
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro p
    change f (p.1, p.2) = 0
    rw [hev, hab.1, hab.2]
    ring
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective c :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp (Submodule.dualAnnihilator_eq_bot_iff.mp ha)
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, h₁⟩ := hsurj (1, 0)
  obtain ⟨ξ₂, h₂⟩ := hsurj (0, 1)
  exact ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, congrArg Prod.fst h₁, congrArg Prod.snd h₁,
    congrArg Prod.fst h₂, congrArg Prod.snd h₂⟩
records.comment:
Two fixed-end C¹ variations can independently correct the two endpoint
coordinates.  This is the concrete rank conclusion used by the implicit
function construction.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_iff_firstVariation {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) :
    Stationary ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η.val s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  unfold Stationary
  constructor <;> intro h η hx hy
  · have hx' := (hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation hℓ hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous).deriv
    have hy' := (hasDerivAt_vertical_variation hℓ hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous).deriv
    have he := (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ η.property.1).deriv
    rw [← he]
    exact h η (hx'.trans hx) (hy'.trans hy)
  · have hx' := (hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation hℓ hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous).deriv
    have hy' := (hasDerivAt_vertical_variation hℓ hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous).deriv
    have he := (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ η.property.1).deriv
    rw [he]
    exact h η (hx'.symm.trans hx) (hy'.symm.trans hy)
records.comment: The integral characterization follows from genuine parameter derivatives.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_angle_firstIntegral_curvature
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hstat : Stationary ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s =
        -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
      (deriv θ s * deriv ε (deriv θ s) - ε (deriv θ s) -
        lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t))) s +
        (deriv θ s) ^ 2 * deriv ε (deriv θ s) -
        deriv θ s * ε (deriv θ s) - σ * deriv θ s = 0)
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hε1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε := hε.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv θ) := hθ.deriv' (n := 2)
  have hε' : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv ε) := hε.deriv' (n := 2)
  have hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) := hε'.comp hκ
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, hAngle⟩ := angleEquation_of_stationary hℓ hθ1 hM
    ((stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ.le hε1 hθ1).mp hstat)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := smooth_angle_firstIntegral_and_curvature hθ hε hAngle
  exact ⟨lam, μ, σ, fun s hs => ⟨hAngle s hs, hσ s hs⟩⟩
records.comment:
Main theorem: genuine linearized constrained stationarity produces force
multipliers, the angle equation, one first-integral constant and the curvature
equation. No rank, convexity, evenness or nonzero curvature is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem firstIntegral_hasDerivAt
    {θ κ M ε : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ s κ' : ℝ}
    (hθ : HasDerivAt θ (κ s) s) (hκ : HasDerivAt κ κ' s)
    (hε : HasDerivAt ε (M s) (κ s))
    (hM : HasDerivAt M (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t => κ t * M t - ε (κ t) - lam * cos (θ t) - μ * sin (θ t)) 0 s
records.proof:
by
  convert (((hκ.mul hM).sub (hε.comp s hκ)).sub
    (hθ.cos.const_mul lam)).sub (hθ.sin.const_mul μ) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | ring
records.comment: Differentiating the usual first integral using the angle equation.

records.statement:
theorem firstIntegral_constant
    {θ κ M ε : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ a b : ℝ}
    (hθ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt θ (κ s) s)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ κ s)
    (hε : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt ε (M s) (κ s))
    (hM : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt M (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      κ s * M s - ε (κ s) - lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ
records.proof:
by
  apply isOpen_Ioo.exists_is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (convex_Ioo a b).isPreconnected
  · intro s hs
    exact (firstIntegral_hasDerivAt (hθ s hs) (hκ s hs).hasDerivAt
      (hε s hs) (hM s hs)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro s hs
    exact (firstIntegral_hasDerivAt (hθ s hs) (hκ s hs).hasDerivAt
      (hε s hs) (hM s hs)).deriv
records.comment: On an open connected interval the first integral is constant.

records.statement:
theorem angleForce_hasDerivAt {θ κ : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ s : ℝ}
    (hθ : HasDerivAt θ (κ s) s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => -lam * sin (θ t) + μ * cos (θ t))
      (-(lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * κ s) s
records.proof:
by
  convert (hθ.sin.const_mul (-lam)).add (hθ.cos.const_mul μ) using 1
  ring
records.comment: Differentiating the right-hand side of the angle equation.

records.statement:
theorem curvature_equation_of_firstIntegral
    {κ M E M'' lam μ θ σ : ℝ}
    (hsecond : M'' = -(lam * cos θ + μ * sin θ) * κ)
    (hfirst : κ * M - E - lam * cos θ - μ * sin θ = σ) :
    M'' + κ ^ 2 * M - κ * E - σ * κ = 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [hsecond]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x * κ) hfirst]
records.comment: Algebraic elimination of the two force components; no division by ε'' occurs.

records.statement:
theorem curvature_equation
    {θ κ ε : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ σ s : ℝ}
    (hsecond : deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (κ t))) s =
      -(lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * κ s)
    (hfirst : κ s * deriv ε (κ s) - ε (κ s) - lam * cos (θ s) -
      μ * sin (θ s) = σ) :
    deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (κ t))) s +
      κ s ^ 2 * deriv ε (κ s) - κ s * ε (κ s) - σ * κ s = 0
records.proof: curvature_equation_of_firstIntegral hsecond hfirst
records.comment: The general curvature equation with the actual density derivative substituted.

records.statement:
theorem second_derivative_of_angle_equation
    {θ κ M : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ a b s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hθ : HasDerivAt θ (κ s) s)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt M (-lam * sin (θ t) + μ * cos (θ t)) t) :
    deriv (deriv M) s = -(lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * κ s
records.proof:
by
  have heq : deriv M =ᶠ[𝓝 s] (fun t => -lam * sin (θ t) + μ * cos (θ t)) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with t ht
    exact (hM t ht).deriv
  exact ((angleForce_hasDerivAt hθ).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).deriv
records.comment:
The second derivative is derived from the angle equation on an open interval.
It is not an extra hypothesis about an independent second-order symbol.

records.statement:
theorem firstIntegral_and_curvature_of_angle
    {θ κ ε : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ a b : ℝ}
    (hθ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt θ (κ s) s)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ κ s)
    (hε : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ ε (κ s))
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv ε (κ t)) (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      (κ s * deriv ε (κ s) - ε (κ s) - lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (κ t))) s +
        κ s ^ 2 * deriv ε (κ s) - κ s * ε (κ s) - σ * κ s = 0)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := firstIntegral_constant hθ hκ (fun s hs => (hε s hs).hasDerivAt) hAngle
  refine ⟨σ, fun s hs => ⟨hσ s hs, ?_⟩⟩
  exact curvature_equation (second_derivative_of_angle_equation hs (hθ s hs) hAngle) (hσ s hs)
records.comment:
From the angle equation to both the first integral and the actual curvature
equation, on the same connected interval. The density derivative is genuine.

records.statement:
theorem smooth_angle_firstIntegral_and_curvature
    {θ ε : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ a b : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      (deriv θ s * deriv ε (deriv θ s) - ε (deriv θ s) -
        lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t))) s +
        (deriv θ s) ^ 2 * deriv ε (deriv θ s) -
        deriv θ s * ε (deriv θ s) - σ * deriv θ s = 0)
records.proof:
by
  have hθd : Differentiable ℝ θ := hθ.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv θ) := hθ.deriv' (n := 2)
  have hε' : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv ε) := hε.deriv' (n := 2)
  have hM : Differentiable ℝ (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) :=
    (hε'.comp hκ).differentiable (by norm_num)
  apply firstIntegral_and_curvature_of_angle (fun s _ => (hθd s).hasDerivAt)
    (fun s _ => hκ.differentiable (by norm_num) s)
    (fun s _ => hε.differentiable (by norm_num) (deriv θ s))
  intro s hs
  exact (hM s).hasDerivAt.congr_deriv (hAngle s hs)
records.comment: C³ angles and densities supply the differentiability hypotheses needed above.

records.statement:
theorem quadratic_density_hasDerivAt (k q : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => k * x ^ 2 / 2) (k * q) q
records.proof:
by
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id q).pow 2).const_mul k).div_const 2 using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq]; ring)
records.comment: Derivative of the quadratic density, with stiffness k retained.

records.statement:
theorem quadratic_moment_second_derivative
    {κ : ℝ → ℝ} (k : ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 κ) (s : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (κ t))) s =
      k * deriv (deriv κ) s
records.proof:
by
  have hfun : (fun t => deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (κ t)) = (fun t => k * κ t) := by
    funext t
    exact (quadratic_density_hasDerivAt k (κ t)).deriv
  rw [hfun]
  have hd : deriv (fun t => k * κ t) = (fun t => k * deriv κ t) := by
    funext t
    exact ((hκ.differentiable (by norm_num) t).hasDerivAt.const_mul k).deriv
  rw [hd]
  exact ((hκ.differentiable_deriv_two s).hasDerivAt.const_mul k).deriv
records.comment: The actual second derivative of ε'(κ) for a quadratic density.

records.statement:
theorem quadratic_curvature_equation
    {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {k σ s : ℝ} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 κ)
    (h : deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (κ t))) s +
      κ s ^ 2 * deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (κ s) -
      κ s * (k * (κ s) ^ 2 / 2) - σ * κ s = 0) :
    k * deriv (deriv κ) s + k * (κ s) ^ 3 / 2 - σ * κ s = 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [quadratic_moment_second_derivative k hκ s,
    (quadratic_density_hasDerivAt k (κ s)).deriv] at h
  nlinarith [h]
records.comment:
A quadratic instance of the actual functional equation is the classical
elastica equation, rather than only a polynomial substitution.

records.statement:
theorem quadratic_curvature_expression (k κ κ'' σ : ℝ) :
    k * κ'' + κ ^ 2 * (k * κ) - κ * (k * κ ^ 2 / 2) - σ * κ =
      k * κ'' + k * κ ^ 3 / 2 - σ * κ
records.proof: by ring
records.comment: Substitution of ε(κ)=kκ²/2 recovers the classical polynomial expression.

records.statement:
theorem affine_density_curvature_expression (κ M E M'' σ a b : ℝ) :
    M'' + κ ^ 2 * (M + a) - κ * (E + a * κ + b) - (σ - b) * κ =
      M'' + κ ^ 2 * M - κ * E - σ * κ
records.proof: by ring
records.comment: An affine change of density changes σ by -b and leaves the equation unchanged.

records.statement:
theorem continuous_parameter_intervalIntegral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {G : Parameters → ℝ → E} {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) :
    Continuous (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s)
records.proof:
by
  have h := continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous (μ := volume) hG
    (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))
  simpa only [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hℓ] using h
records.comment: Continuity of a compact interval integral, for a continuous joint integrand.

records.statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {G : Parameters → ℝ → E} {D : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] E}
    {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) (hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D))
    (hd : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q s) (D p s) p) (p₀ : Parameters) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s) (∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p₀ s) p₀
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall p₀ 1).prod (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hD.continuousOn
  have hGs (p : Parameters) : Continuous (G p) := hG.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hDs (p : Parameters) : Continuous (D p) := hD.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
    (s := ball p₀ 1) (bound := fun _ => C) (ball_mem_nhds p₀ one_pos)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun p => (hGs p).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((hGs p₀).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) (hDs p₀).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards [] with s hs
    rw [uIoc_of_le hℓ] at hs
    intro p hp
    exact hC (p, s) ⟨ball_subset_closedBall hp, ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩⟩
  · exact continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  · filter_upwards [] with s _ p _
    exact hd p s
records.comment:
A continuous parameter derivative on a compact rectangle supplies the bound
needed to differentiate the actual interval integral.

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_two_parameter_intervalIntegral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {G : Parameters → ℝ → E} {D : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] E}
    {D₂ : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] (Parameters →L[ℝ] E)}
    {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) (hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D))
    (hD₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry D₂))
    (hd : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q s) (D p s) p)
    (hd₂ : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => D q s) (D₂ p s) p) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s)
records.proof:
by
  have h₁ := hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral hℓ hG hD hd
  have h₂ := hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral hℓ hD hD₂ hd₂
  have heq : fderiv ℝ (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s) = fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p s :=
    funext fun p => (h₁ p).fderiv
  rw [show (2 : WithTop ENat) = 1 + 1 from rfl, contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv]
  refine ⟨fun p => (h₁ p).differentiableAt, by simp, ?_⟩
  rw [heq, contDiff_one_iff_fderiv]
  refine ⟨fun p => (h₂ p).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  have heq₂ : fderiv ℝ (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p s) = fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D₂ p s :=
    funext fun p => (h₂ p).fderiv
  rw [heq₂]
  exact continuous_parameter_intervalIntegral hℓ hD₂
records.comment: Two continuous actual parameter derivatives yield C² of the actual integral.

records.statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_integral_linear_parameters
    {ρ κ : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ρ) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hB : Continuous B)
    (p : Parameters) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ρ (κ s + B s p))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s) p
records.proof:
by
  have hp : Continuous (fun q : Parameters × ℝ => κ q.2 + B q.2 q.1) :=
    (hκ.comp continuous_snd).add ((hB.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply continuous_fst)
  apply hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral
    (G := fun p s => ρ (κ s + B s p))
    (D := fun p s => deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s) hℓ (hρ.continuous.comp hp)
    ((hρ.continuous_deriv_one.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  intro p s
  exact (hρ.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
    ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_two_integral_linear_parameters
    {ρ κ : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ 2 ρ) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hB : Continuous B) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ρ (κ s + B s p))
records.proof:
by
  let D := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) => deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s
  let D₂ := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) =>
    (deriv (deriv ρ) (κ s + B s p) • B s).smulRight (B s)
  have hp : Continuous (fun q : Parameters × ℝ => κ q.2 + B q.2 q.1) :=
    (hκ.comp continuous_snd).add ((hB.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply continuous_fst)
  have hρ₁ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (deriv ρ) := hρ.deriv'
  have hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D) :=
    ((hρ₁.continuous.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  have hD₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry D₂) := by
    dsimp [D₂, Function.uncurry]
    exact (isBoundedBilinearMap_smulRight (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := Parameters)
      (F := Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ)).continuous.comp
      (((hρ₁.continuous_deriv_one.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd)).prodMk
        (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  apply contDiff_two_parameter_intervalIntegral
    (G := fun p s => ρ (κ s + B s p)) (D := D) (D₂ := D₂)
    hℓ (hρ.continuous.comp hp) hD hD₂
  · intro p s
    exact (hρ.differentiable (by norm_num) _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))
  · intro p s
    exact ((hρ₁.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))).smul_const (B s)

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_endpointParameters {θ η u v : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η)
    (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (endpointParameters θ η u v ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  exact (contDiff_two_integral_linear_parameters hℓ Real.contDiff_cos hθ
    (continuous_parameterLinear hη hu hv)).prodMk
    (contDiff_two_integral_linear_parameters hℓ Real.contDiff_sin hθ
      (continuous_parameterLinear hη hu hv))

records.statement:
theorem fderiv_endpointParameters_zero {θ η u v : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η)
    (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v) (p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    fderiv ℝ (endpointParameters θ η u v ℓ) 0 p =
      (p.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η s) +
        p.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * u s) +
        p.2.2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * v s),
       p.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η s) +
        p.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * u s) +
        p.2.2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * v s))
records.proof:
by
  have hB := continuous_parameterLinear hη hu hv
  have hc := hasFDerivAt_integral_linear_parameters hℓ Real.contDiff_cos hθ hB (0 : Parameters)
  have hs := hasFDerivAt_integral_linear_parameters hℓ Real.contDiff_sin hθ hB (0 : Parameters)
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (endpointParameters θ η u v ℓ)
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s).prod
       (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s)) 0 := by
    convert hc.prodMk hs using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | simp only [map_zero, add_zero, Real.deriv_cos, Real.deriv_sin]
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s) p = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply
      (φ := fun s => -sin (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s) (μ := volume) (v := p)
      (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).neg.smul hB).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)]
    simpa only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply, Pi.neg_apply] using
      integral_parameterLinear hη hu hv (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).neg p
  · change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s) p = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply
      (φ := fun s => cos (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s) (μ := volume) (v := p)
      (((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).smul hB).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)]
    simpa only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply] using
      integral_parameterLinear hη hu hv (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ) p

records.statement:
theorem exists_implicit_correction {f : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) → ℝ × ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (ht : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) = 0)
    (hc : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g 0 ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧ HasDerivAt g 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, f (t, g t) = f 0
records.proof:
by
  have hi : ((fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hc]
    exact ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ), rfl⟩
  let h := hf.contDiffAt (x := (0 : Parameters))
  let g := h.implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi
  refine ⟨g, h.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi,
    h.implicitFunction_apply_self (by norm_num) hi, ?_,
    h.eventually_apply_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi⟩
  have hd := h.hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi
  rw [ht] at hd
  simpa using hd.hasFDerivAt.hasDerivAt
records.comment:
Genuine finite-dimensional IFT, specialized to an identity correction block
and a zero tangent block. No solution function is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem exists_exact_endpoint_variation {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0)
    (η : variationSpace ℓ)
    (hηx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hηy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ, ∃ a b : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0 ∧
      a 0 = 0 ∧ b 0 = 0 ∧ HasDerivAt a 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt b 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, hx₁, hy₁, hx₂, hy₂⟩ := exists_normalized_constraint_directions hℓ hθ hne
  let f := endpointParameters θ η.val ξ₁.val ξ₂.val ℓ
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f := contDiff_endpointParameters hℓ.le hθ.continuous
    η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous
  have ht : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro t
    change fderiv ℝ f 0 (t, (0, 0)) = (0, 0)
    rw [fderiv_endpointParameters_zero hℓ.le hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous]
    rw [hηx, hηy]
    simp
  have hc : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro p
    change fderiv ℝ f 0 (0, p) = p
    rw [fderiv_endpointParameters_zero hℓ.le hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous]
    rw [hx₁, hy₁, hx₂, hy₂]
    simp
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg₀, hgd, hge⟩ := exists_implicit_correction hf ht hc
  refine ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, (fun t => (g t).1), (fun t => (g t).2), hg.fst, hg.snd,
    congrArg Prod.fst hg₀, congrArg Prod.snd hg₀, hgd.fst, hgd.snd, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hge] with t ht
  constructor
  · have hx := congrArg Prod.fst ht
    simpa [f, endpointParameters, parameterLinear_apply, add_assoc] using hx
  · have hy := congrArg Prod.snd ht
    simpa [f, endpointParameters, parameterLinear_apply, add_assoc] using hy
records.comment:
Every linearized feasible C¹ direction at a nonstraight curve is tangent to
an actual C²-parameter family preserving both endpoint positions exactly.
The two correction directions have zero endpoint values by their subtype.

records.proof:
by
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).mul_const (η s)).const_add (θ s) |>.add
    (ha.mul_const (u s)) |>.add (hb.mul_const (v s))) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
records.comment: The correction terms vanish to first order, so the realized tangent is η.

records.statement:
theorem corrected_angle_endpoints {θ a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (η u v : variationSpace ℓ) (t : ℝ) :
    (θ 0 + t * η.val 0 + a t * u.val 0 + b t * v.val 0 = θ 0) ∧
    (θ ℓ + t * η.val ℓ + a t * u.val ℓ + b t * v.val ℓ = θ ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  simp [η.property.2.1, η.property.2.2, u.property.2.1, u.property.2.2,
    v.property.2.1, v.property.2.2]
records.comment: Correction by fixed-end angle variations preserves both prescribed angles.

records.statement:
theorem energy_const (ε : ℝ → ℝ) (α ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun _ => α) ℓ = ℓ * ε 0
records.proof:
by
  simp [energy]
records.comment: A constant tangent angle has zero curvature and constant energy density.

records.statement:
theorem energy_affine (ε : ℝ → ℝ) (α c ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => α + c * s) ℓ = ℓ * ε c
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  simp_rw [show ∀ s : ℝ, deriv (fun u => α + c * u) s = c from
    fun s => curvature_affine α c s]
  simp
records.comment: An affine tangent angle has constant signed curvature, hence this exact energy.

records.statement:
theorem integral_curvature {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv θ s) = θ ℓ - θ 0
records.proof:
by
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub
    (fun s _ => hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s)
    (hθ.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
records.comment: The linear curvature term integrates to the difference of the lifted end angles.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_affine_fixed_end_variation {ε η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η)
    (h0 : η 0 = 0) (hend : η ℓ = 0) (α c : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation (fun s => α + c * s) η t) ℓ) 0 0
records.proof:
by
  have h := hasDerivAt_energy_variation (θ := fun s => α + c * s) hℓ hε
    (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)) hη
  have hi : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv (fun u => α + c * u) s) * deriv η s) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [show ∀ s : ℝ, deriv (fun u => α + c * u) s = c from
      fun s => curvature_affine α c s]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_curvature hη]
    simp [h0, hend]
  simpa only [hi] using h
records.comment:
Straight lines and circular arcs have zero actual first variation under
fixed-end-angle variations. This proves stationarity, not minimum energy.

records.statement:
theorem energy_affine_density {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hε : Continuous ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (a b ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) θ ℓ =
      energy ε θ ℓ + a * (θ ℓ - θ 0) + b * ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have he : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => ε (deriv θ s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (hε.comp hθ.continuous_deriv_one).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  have ha : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => a * deriv θ s) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul hθ.continuous_deriv_one).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  unfold energy
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (he.add ha) intervalIntegrable_const,
    intervalIntegral.integral_add he ha, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
    integral_curvature hθ]
  simp [mul_comm]
records.comment: Adding `a κ + b` to the density changes the actual energy only by boundary data.

records.statement:
theorem affine_density_shift_same_end_angles {ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (a b ℓ : ℝ) (h0 : θ 0 = ψ 0) (hℓ : θ ℓ = ψ ℓ) :
    energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) θ ℓ - energy ε θ ℓ =
      energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) ψ ℓ - energy ε ψ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_affine_density hε hθ, energy_affine_density hε hψ, h0, hℓ]
  ring
records.comment:
For a fixed angle branch and length, the affine-density correction is the
same for any two curves sharing both lifted endpoint angles.

records.statement:
theorem reflection_counterexample :
    energy (fun q : ℝ => q) (fun s : ℝ => s) 1 = 1 ∧
    energy (fun q : ℝ => q) (fun s : ℝ => -s) 1 = -1
records.proof:
by
  simp [energy]
records.comment: An exact failure of reflection invariance for a density that is not even.

records.statement:
theorem energy_reflection_of_even {ε : ℝ → ℝ} (hε : ∀ q, ε (-q) = ε q)
    (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => -θ s) ℓ = energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s _
  change ε (deriv (fun u => -θ u) s) = ε (deriv θ s)
  rw [show deriv (fun u => -θ u) s = -deriv θ s from deriv.neg]
  exact hε _
records.comment: Evenness of the density is sufficient for reflection invariance of the energy.

records.statement:
theorem energy_rotation (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (α ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => θ s + α) ℓ = energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  simp only [energy, deriv_add_const]
records.comment: A rigid rotation adds a constant to the angle and preserves energy for any density.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_pos (β : ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    0 < exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof: exp_pos _

records.statement:
theorem log_exponentialWeight (β : ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    log (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) = -β * energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof: log_exp _

records.statement:
theorem energy_eq_neg_log_exponentialWeight {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ = -log (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) / β
records.proof:
by
  rw [log_exponentialWeight]
  field_simp
records.comment: No sign condition on the energy is needed to recover it by a logarithm.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_split {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (β a ℓ : ℝ) :
    exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ =
      exponentialWeight β ε θ a * exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)))
records.proof:
by
  have hc := hε.comp hθ.continuous_deriv_one
  have he := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume)
    (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 a) (hc.intervalIntegrable a ℓ)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at he
  unfold exponentialWeight energy
  rw [← he, mul_add, exp_add]
records.comment:
Adjacent intervals compose multiplicatively. Oriented integrals make the
identity valid without an ordering hypothesis on the cut.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_split_three {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (β a b ℓ : ℝ) :
    exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ =
      exp (-β * (∫ s in 0..a, ε (deriv θ s))) *
      exp (-β * (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s))) *
      exp (-β * (∫ s in b..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)))
records.proof:
by
  rw [exponentialWeight, energy_split_three hε hθ a b ℓ]
  rw [mul_add, mul_add, exp_add, exp_add]
records.comment: The existing three-piece energy decomposition gives three multiplicative factors.

records.statement:
theorem exp_neg_mul_le_exp_neg_mul_iff {β x y : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    exp (-β * x) ≤ exp (-β * y) ↔ y ≤ x
records.proof:
by
  rw [exp_le_exp]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

records.statement:
theorem exp_neg_mul_lt_exp_neg_mul_iff {β x y : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    exp (-β * x) < exp (-β * y) ↔ y < x
records.proof:
by
  rw [exp_lt_exp]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

records.statement:
theorem energy_le_iff_exponentialWeight_le {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ ≤ energy ε ψ ℓ ↔
      exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof: (exp_neg_mul_le_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ).symm
records.comment: The same curves are compared, with the order reversed.

records.statement:
theorem energy_lt_iff_exponentialWeight_lt {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ < energy ε ψ ℓ ↔
      exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ < exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof: (exp_neg_mul_lt_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ).symm

records.statement:
theorem energy_minimum_iff_exponentialWeight_maximum {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) (S : Set (ℝ → ℝ)) :
    (∀ ψ ∈ S, energy ε θ ℓ ≤ energy ε ψ ℓ) ↔
      (∀ ψ ∈ S, exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  simp only [energy_le_iff_exponentialWeight_le hβ]
records.comment: Global extrema correspond on any one fixed feasible set.

records.statement:
theorem isLocalMinOn_iff_isLocalMaxOn_exp_neg_mul
    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (f : α → ℝ) (S : Set α) (x : α) :
    IsLocalMinOn f S x ↔ IsLocalMaxOn (fun y => exp (-β * f y)) S x
records.proof:
by
  change (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[S] x, f x ≤ f y) ↔
    (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[S] x, exp (-β * f y) ≤ exp (-β * f x))
  simp only [exp_neg_mul_le_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ]
records.comment: Local extrema also correspond, including on a restricted feasible set.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_iff_exponentialWeight_local_maximum
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
        ψ 0 = θ 0 → ψ ℓ = θ ℓ →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) →
        (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
          |ψ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv ψ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
        exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  simp only [LocallyMinimizing, energy_le_iff_exponentialWeight_le hβ]
records.comment: The original C¹ constrained neighborhood and boundary conditions are retained.

records.proof:
by
  convert (hf.const_mul (-β)).exp using 1
  ring
records.comment: Chain rule for an actual scalar parameter derivative.

records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have h := (hw.log (exp_ne_zero _)).const_mul (-(β⁻¹))
    simpa only [log_exp, neg_mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hβ, one_mul] using h
  · intro hf
    exact (hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf.hasDerivAt).differentiableAt
records.comment: The logarithmic inverse transports actual differentiability back to the energy.

records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have hf := (differentiableAt_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ).mp hw.differentiableAt
    have he := (hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf.hasDerivAt).unique hw
    have hd : deriv f x = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp he with h | h
      · exact False.elim ((mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hβ) (exp_ne_zero _)) h)
      · exact h
    simpa only [hd] using hf.hasDerivAt
  · intro hf
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf
records.comment: Stationarity equivalence is about actual derivatives, not an assumed formula.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_exp_neg_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => exp (-β * f t)) x = -β * exp (-β * f x) * deriv f x
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x
  · exact (hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf.hasDerivAt).deriv
  · have hw : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => exp (-β * f t)) x :=
      fun h => hf ((differentiableAt_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ).mp h)
    simp only [deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hf,
      deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hw, mul_zero]
records.comment:
The total derivative formula also holds where the inner function is not
differentiable: the logarithmic inverse forces both total derivatives to be zero.

records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_exp_neg_mul hβ]
  simp only [mul_eq_zero, neg_eq_zero, hβ, exp_ne_zero, false_or]

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x d q β : ℝ}
    (hβ : β ≠ 0) (hf : HasDerivAt f d x) (hsecond : HasDerivAt (deriv f) q x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exp (-β * f t)))
      (β ^ 2 * exp (-β * f x) * d ^ 2 - β * exp (-β * f x) * q) x
records.proof:
by
  have he : deriv (fun t => exp (-β * f t)) =
      fun t => -β * exp (-β * f t) * deriv f t :=
    funext (deriv_exp_neg_mul hβ)
  rw [he]
  convert ((hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf).const_mul (-β)).mul hsecond using 1
  rw [hf.deriv]
  ring
records.comment:
Actual scalar second derivative, requiring only the two stated derivative
facts at the point. The extra square term is retained away from stationarity.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul_of_stationary {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x q β : ℝ}
    (hβ : β ≠ 0) (hf : HasDerivAt f 0 x) (hsecond : HasDerivAt (deriv f) q x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exp (-β * f t)))
      (-β * exp (-β * f x) * q) x
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_mul] using
    hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul hβ hf hsecond
records.comment:
At a stationary point the second derivative changes by the negative factor
`-β * exp (-β * f x)` when `β > 0`. No minimality is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_exponentialWeight_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (β : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      (-β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hzero : angleVariation θ η 0 = θ := by
    funext s
    simp only [angleVariation, zero_mul, add_zero]
  simpa only [exponentialWeight, hzero] using
    hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη)
records.comment: The first derivative uses the already proved differentiation of the actual energy.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_variation_stationary_iff {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) 0 0 ↔
      HasDerivAt (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) 0 0
records.proof: hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul_zero_iff hβ
records.comment: Stationarity along each actual energy variation is unchanged for nonzero `β`.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_iff_exponentialWeight_stationary {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    Stationary ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
        deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η.val s)) 0 = 0 →
        deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s)) 0 = 0 →
        deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η.val t) ℓ) 0 = 0
records.proof:
by
  simp only [Stationary, exponentialWeight, deriv_exp_neg_mul_eq_zero_iff hβ]
records.comment:
The existing stationarity predicate uses the same fixed-angle directions and
the same two linearized displacement constraints after the change of representation.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_exponentialWeight_variation
    {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ))
      (β ^ 2 * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s) ^ 2 -
        β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s) ^ 2)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hzero : angleVariation θ η 0 = θ := by
    funext s
    simp only [angleVariation, zero_mul, add_zero]
  simpa only [exponentialWeight, hzero] using hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul hβ
    (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ hη)
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη)
records.comment:
The full second derivative along the actual additive angle family. This
family need not preserve endpoint positions; hence the square term is retained.
