records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_exponentialWeight_family_of_stationary
    {ε : ℝ → ℝ} {Θ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x q β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hfirst : HasDerivAt (fun t => energy ε (Θ t) ℓ) 0 x)
    (hsecond : HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => energy ε (Θ t) ℓ)) q x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (Θ t) ℓ))
      (-β * exponentialWeight β ε (Θ x) ℓ * q) x
records.proof: hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul_of_stationary hβ hfirst hsecond
records.comment:
Any actual stationary energy path, in particular an exact admissible family,
has the stated weighted second derivative. The input `hsecond` is a derivative
of the actual energy path, not a separately defined quadratic expression.

records.statement:
theorem constrained_secondVariation_exponentialWeight_corrected
    {ε θ a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ lam μ β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (η ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0)
    (hx : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s))
    (hy : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))
    (hstat : ∀ ζ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ))
      (-β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
          (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hdx := (hasDerivAt_corrected_integral_and_deriv (ε := cos) hℓ contDiff_cos
    hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous
    ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).1
  have hdy := (hasDerivAt_corrected_integral_and_deriv (ε := sin) hℓ contDiff_sin
    hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous
    ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).1
  have hxI : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 := by
    have h := hdx.deriv
    rw [hx.deriv_eq] at h
    simpa only [Real.deriv_cos, deriv_const] using h.symm
  have hyI : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 := by
    have h := hdy.deriv
    rw [hy.deriv_eq] at h
    simpa only [Real.deriv_sin, deriv_const] using h.symm
  have hz : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η.val s) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hxI, hyI, mul_zero, add_zero] using hstat η
  have he := (hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_and_deriv hℓ hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁.property.1 ξ₂.property.1 ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).1
  rw [hz] at he
  have hsecond := constrained_secondVariation_corrected hℓ hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁ ξ₂ ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1 hx hy hstat
  have h := hasDerivAt_deriv_exponentialWeight_family_of_stationary hβ he hsecond
  simpa only [ha0, hb0, zero_mul, add_zero] using h
records.comment:
On the existing exact constrained corrected family, stationarity removes
both the first-derivative square and the acceleration terms. The constrained
second variation is therefore multiplied by `-β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ`.
The exact displacement hypotheses are used to derive first-order feasibility;
that feasibility is not separately assumed.

records.statement: @[simp] theorem xCoord_zero (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) : xCoord θ x₀ 0 = x₀
records.proof:
by
  simp [xCoord]

records.statement: @[simp] theorem yCoord_zero (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (y₀ : ℝ) : yCoord θ y₀ 0 = y₀
records.proof:
by
  simp [yCoord]

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_xCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (x₀ s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (xCoord θ x₀) (Real.cos (θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  exact (((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 s).hasDerivAt.const_add x₀)

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_yCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (y₀ s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (yCoord θ y₀) (Real.sin (θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  exact (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 s).hasDerivAt.const_add y₀)

records.statement:
theorem deriv_xCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (x₀ s : ℝ) :
    deriv (xCoord θ x₀) s = Real.cos (θ s)
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ x₀ s).deriv

records.statement:
theorem deriv_yCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (y₀ s : ℝ) :
    deriv (yCoord θ y₀) s = Real.sin (θ s)
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ y₀ s).deriv

records.statement:
theorem unit_speed_squared {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (x₀ y₀ s : ℝ) :
    (deriv (xCoord θ x₀) s)^2 + (deriv (yCoord θ y₀) s)^2 = 1
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_xCoord hθ, deriv_yCoord hθ]
  exact Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq _
records.comment: The reconstructed curve has Euclidean speed one.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_xCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    {κ s : ℝ} (hθ' : HasDerivAt θ κ s) (x₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (xCoord θ x₀)) (-Real.sin (θ s) * κ) s
records.proof:
by
  have hx : deriv (xCoord θ x₀) = fun u => Real.cos (θ u) :=
    funext (deriv_xCoord hθ x₀)
  rw [hx]
  exact hθ'.cos

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_yCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    {κ s : ℝ} (hθ' : HasDerivAt θ κ s) (y₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (yCoord θ y₀)) (Real.cos (θ s) * κ) s
records.proof:
by
  have hy : deriv (yCoord θ y₀) = fun u => Real.sin (θ u) :=
    funext (deriv_yCoord hθ y₀)
  rw [hy]
  exact hθ'.sin

records.statement:
theorem signed_curvature_determinant {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    {κ s : ℝ} (hθ' : HasDerivAt θ κ s) (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    deriv (xCoord θ x₀) s * deriv (deriv (yCoord θ y₀)) s -
      deriv (yCoord θ y₀) s * deriv (deriv (xCoord θ x₀)) s = κ
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_xCoord hθ, deriv_yCoord hθ,
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_xCoord hθ hθ' x₀).deriv,
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_yCoord hθ hθ' y₀).deriv]
  calc
    _ = (Real.cos (θ s)^2 + Real.sin (θ s)^2) * κ := by ring
    _ = κ := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]; simp
records.comment: For the unit-speed reconstruction, `x' y'' - y' x'' = θ'`.

records.statement:
theorem signed_curvature_eq_deriv {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    (x₀ y₀ s : ℝ) :
    deriv (xCoord θ x₀) s * deriv (deriv (yCoord θ y₀)) s -
      deriv (yCoord θ y₀) s * deriv (deriv (xCoord θ x₀)) s = curvature θ s
records.proof: signed_curvature_determinant hθ.continuous (hθ s).hasDerivAt x₀ y₀

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_const (α x₀ s : ℝ) :
    xCoord (fun _ => α) x₀ s = x₀ + s * Real.cos α
records.proof:
by
  simp [xCoord]
records.comment: A constant angle reconstructs a straight line.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_const (α y₀ s : ℝ) :
    yCoord (fun _ => α) y₀ s = y₀ + s * Real.sin α
records.proof:
by
  simp [yCoord]

records.statement: @[simp] theorem curvature_const (α s : ℝ) : curvature (fun _ => α) s = 0
records.proof:
by
  simp [curvature]

records.statement:
theorem curvature_affine (α κ s : ℝ) :
    curvature (fun u => α + κ * u) s = κ
records.proof:
by
  simp [curvature]
records.comment: The linear angle of a circular arc has the specified constant signed curvature.

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_affine (α κ x₀ s : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0) :
    xCoord (fun u => α + κ * u) x₀ s =
      x₀ + (Real.sin (α + κ * s) - Real.sin α) / κ
records.proof:
by
  have hd (u : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun v => Real.sin (α + κ * v) / κ)
        (Real.cos (α + κ * u)) u := by
    simpa [hκ] using
      (((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul κ |>.const_add α).sin.div_const κ)
  have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s) (fun u _ => hd u)
    ((Real.continuous_cos.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))).intervalIntegrable 0 s)
  unfold xCoord
  rw [hi]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
  ring
records.comment: A nonzero affine angle reconstructs the classical circular arc.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_affine (α κ y₀ s : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0) :
    yCoord (fun u => α + κ * u) y₀ s =
      y₀ + (Real.cos α - Real.cos (α + κ * s)) / κ
records.proof:
by
  have hd (u : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun v => -Real.cos (α + κ * v) / κ)
        (Real.sin (α + κ * u)) u := by
    simpa [hκ] using
      ((((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul κ |>.const_add α).cos.neg).div_const κ)
  have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s) (fun u _ => hd u)
    ((Real.continuous_sin.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))).intervalIntegrable 0 s)
  unfold yCoord
  rw [hi]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
  ring

records.statement:
theorem abs_x_displacement_le (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    |xCoord θ x₀ ℓ - x₀| ≤ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := ℓ) (C := (1 : ℝ))
    (f := fun u => Real.cos (θ u))
    (fun u _ => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_cos_le_one (θ u))
  simpa [xCoord, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hℓ] using h
records.comment:
A necessary endpoint condition. In particular an x-displacement greater than
the length cannot be attained, irrespective of tangent boundary conditions.

records.statement:
theorem abs_y_displacement_le (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (y₀ ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    |yCoord θ y₀ ℓ - y₀| ≤ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := ℓ) (C := (1 : ℝ))
    (f := fun u => Real.sin (θ u))
    (fun u _ => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_sin_le_one (θ u))
  simpa [yCoord, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hℓ] using h

records.statement:
theorem impossible_x_endpoint {x₀ x₁ ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hfar : ℓ < |x₁ - x₀|) : ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ → ℝ, xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₁
records.proof:
by
  rintro ⟨θ, hθ⟩
  have h := abs_x_displacement_le θ x₀ ℓ hℓ
  rw [hθ] at h
  exact (not_lt_of_ge h) hfar

records.statement:
theorem corrected_family_C1_close {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (η ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ)
    {a b : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousAt a 0) (hb : ContinuousAt b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      |(θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) - θ s| < r ∧
      |deriv (fun u => θ u + t * η.val u + a t * ξ₁.val u + b t * ξ₂.val u) s -
        deriv θ s| < r
records.proof:
by
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    |η.val s| + |deriv η.val s| + |ξ₁.val s| + |deriv ξ₁.val s| +
      |ξ₂.val s| + |deriv ξ₂.val s|
  have hG : Continuous G :=
    ((((η.property.1.continuous.abs.add η.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs).add
      ξ₁.property.1.continuous.abs).add ξ₁.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs).add
        ξ₂.property.1.continuous.abs).add ξ₂.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hG.continuousOn
  have hbounds (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ) :
      |η.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv η.val s| ≤ C ∧
      |ξ₁.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv ξ₁.val s| ≤ C ∧
      |ξ₂.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv ξ₂.val s| ≤ C := by
    have hg : G s ≤ C := (le_abs_self (G s)).trans (by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC s hs)
    dsimp [G] at hg
    have h₁ := abs_nonneg (η.val s)
    have h₂ := abs_nonneg (deriv η.val s)
    have h₃ := abs_nonneg (ξ₁.val s)
    have h₄ := abs_nonneg (deriv ξ₁.val s)
    have h₅ := abs_nonneg (ξ₂.val s)
    have h₆ := abs_nonneg (deriv ξ₂.val s)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => (|t| + |a t| + |b t|) * C) 0 :=
    ((continuousAt_id.abs.add ha.abs).add hb.abs).mul continuousAt_const
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), (|t| + |a t| + |b t|) * C < r :=
    hcont.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by simpa [ha0, hb0] using hr))
  filter_upwards [hsmall] with t ht
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ := hbounds s hs
  have hd : deriv (fun u => θ u + t * η.val u + a t * ξ₁.val u + b t * ξ₂.val u) s =
      deriv θ s + t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s + b t * deriv ξ₂.val s :=
    ((((hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.add
      ((η.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul t)).add
        ((ξ₁.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (a t))).add
          ((ξ₂.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (b t))).deriv
  constructor
  · have he : θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s - θ s =
        t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact (abs_three_term_bound h₁ h₃ h₅).trans_lt ht
  · rw [hd]
    have he : deriv θ s + t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s +
        b t * deriv ξ₂.val s - deriv θ s =
        t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s + b t * deriv ξ₂.val s := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact (abs_three_term_bound h₂ h₄ h₆).trans_lt ht
records.comment:
A continuous finite-parameter correction tending to zero tends to the base
angle in the C¹ neighborhood on the fixed compact interval.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ)
    (η ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ) {a b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContinuousAt a 0) (hb : ContinuousAt b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ),
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))) :
    IsLocalMin (fun t => energy ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ) 0
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hminimal⟩ := hmin
  have hclose := corrected_family_C1_close hθ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ha hb ha0 hb0 hr
  change ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ),
    energy ε (fun s => θ s + 0 * η.val s + a 0 * ξ₁.val s + b 0 * ξ₂.val s) ℓ ≤ _
  simp only [ha0, hb0, zero_mul, add_zero]
  filter_upwards [hclose, hexact] with t ht hx
  apply hminimal (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)
  · exact ((hθ.add (contDiff_const.mul η.property.1)).add
      (contDiff_const.mul ξ₁.property.1)).add (contDiff_const.mul ξ₂.property.1)
  · simp only [η.property.2.1, ξ₁.property.2.1, ξ₂.property.2.1, mul_zero, add_zero]
  · simp only [η.property.2.2, ξ₁.property.2.2, ξ₂.property.2.2, mul_zero, add_zero]
  · exact hx.1
  · exact hx.2
  · exact ht
records.comment:
A C¹ local minimum of the constrained energy induces a scalar local minimum
on every exact corrected family with continuous coefficients vanishing at zero.
The hypotheses from a C² implicit-function correction are therefore sufficient.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_stationary_of_nonstraight {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) : Stationary ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  apply (stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ.le (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ).mpr
  intro η hx hy
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, a, b, ha, hb, ha0, hb0, ha1, hb1, hexact⟩ :=
    exists_exact_endpoint_variation hℓ hθ hne η hx hy
  have hm := locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family hθ hmin η ξ₁ ξ₂
    ha.continuousAt hb.continuousAt ha0 hb0 hexact
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_and_deriv hℓ.le hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁.property.1 ξ₂.property.1 ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1.deriv hb1.deriv).1
  exact hd.deriv.symm.trans hm.deriv_eq_zero
records.comment:
A genuine C¹ local minimum at a nonstraight curve satisfies the original
stationarity predicate, which is stated using actual parameter derivatives.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_angle_firstIntegral_curvature
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s =
        -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
      (deriv θ s * deriv ε (deriv θ s) - ε (deriv θ s) -
        lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t))) s +
        (deriv θ s) ^ 2 * deriv ε (deriv θ s) -
        deriv θ s * ε (deriv θ s) - σ * deriv θ s = 0)
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  exact stationary_angle_firstIntegral_curvature hℓ hε hθ
    (locallyMinimizing_stationary_of_nonstraight hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ1
      (exists_nonzero_curvature_of_nonconstant hℓ hθ1 hne) hmin)
records.comment:
The existing angle, first-integral and curvature equations now follow
from a true constrained local minimum; no stationarity hypothesis is supplied.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_secondVariation_nonneg
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ lam μ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ)
    (hm : ∀ ζ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0)
    (η : variationSpace ℓ)
    (hx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0) :
    0 ≤ ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
      (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, a, b, ha, hb, ha0, hb0, ha1, hb1, hexact⟩ :=
    exists_exact_endpoint_variation hℓ hθ hne η hx hy
  have hpath := locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family hθ hmin η ξ₁ ξ₂
    ha.continuousAt hb.continuousAt ha0 hb0 hexact
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_and_deriv hℓ.le hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁.property.1 ξ₂.property.1 ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1.deriv hb1.deriv).1
  have hsecond := constrained_secondVariation_corrected hℓ.le hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁ ξ₂ ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1.deriv hb1.deriv
    (hexact.mono fun _ h => h.1) (hexact.mono fun _ h => h.2) hm
  exact second_derivative_nonneg_of_local_min hpath hd.continuousAt hsecond
records.comment:
Every linearized feasible direction at a nonstraight local minimum has
nonnegative constrained second variation, for any stationary multipliers.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_necessary_conditions
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ,
      (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
        (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s =
          -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
        (deriv θ s * deriv ε (deriv θ s) - ε (deriv θ s) -
          lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
        (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t))) s +
          (deriv θ s) ^ 2 * deriv ε (deriv θ s) -
          deriv θ s * ε (deriv θ s) - σ * deriv θ s = 0)) ∧
      (∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        0 ≤ ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
          (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2)
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hε1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε := hε.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hε2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε := hε.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hn := exists_nonzero_curvature_of_nonconstant hℓ hθ1 hne
  have hstat := locallyMinimizing_stationary_of_nonstraight hℓ hε2 hθ1 hn hmin
  have hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) :=
    (hε.deriv' (n := 2)).comp (hθ.deriv' (n := 2))
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, hm⟩ := stationary_multipliers hθ.continuous hM.continuous
    ((stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ.le hε1 hθ1).mp hstat)
  have hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s) := by
    apply residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary hℓ hM
      ((contDiff_const.mul hθ1.sin).add (contDiff_const.mul hθ1.cos))
    intro η
    rw [force_integral hθ.continuous η]
    linarith [hm η]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := smooth_angle_firstIntegral_and_curvature hθ hε hAngle
  refine ⟨lam, μ, σ, (fun s hs => ⟨hAngle s hs, hσ s hs⟩), ?_⟩
  exact locallyMinimizing_secondVariation_nonneg hℓ hε2 hθ1 hn hmin hm
records.comment:
Complete necessary-condition theorem. A nonstraight C¹ constrained local
minimum with the original C³ data has one choice of multipliers that satisfies
all three classical equations and the constrained second-variation inequality.
Neither stationarity, exact variation realization, nor rank is assumed.

records.statement: @[simp] theorem powerLog_zero (z : ℝ) : powerLog 0 z = log z
records.proof:
by
  simp [powerLog]

records.statement: @[simp] theorem powerLog_one (p : ℝ) : powerLog p 1 = 0
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hp : p = 0 <;> simp [powerLog, hp]

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_powerLog {p z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    HasDerivAt (powerLog p) (z ^ (p - 1)) z
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    unfold powerLog
    simpa [Real.rpow_neg_one] using Real.hasDerivAt_log hz.ne'
  · unfold powerLog
    simp only [hp, ite_false]
    convert ((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := p) (Or.inl hz.ne')).sub_const 1).div_const p using 1
    field_simp
records.comment: Every exponent gives the same first-order normalization at `z = 1`.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_powerLog {p z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    deriv (powerLog p) z = z ^ (p - 1)
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_powerLog hz).deriv

records.statement:
theorem deriv_powerLog_pos {p z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    0 < deriv (powerLog p) z
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_powerLog hz]
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hz _

records.statement:
theorem powerLog_mul (p : ℝ) {z w : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (hw : 0 < w) :
    powerLog p (z * w) = powerLog p z + powerLog p w + p * powerLog p z * powerLog p w
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp [powerLog, Real.log_mul hz.ne' hw.ne']
  · simp only [powerLog, hp, ite_false]
    rw [Real.mul_rpow hz.le hw.le]
    field_simp
    ring
records.comment:
The exact transported multiplication law; at exponent zero it is logarithmic
additivity. This identity is not an identification of two empirical response laws.

records.statement:
theorem continuousAt_powerLog_exponent_zero {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p => powerLog p z) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun p : ℝ => z ^ p) (log z) 0 := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) z).rpow (hasDerivAt_id 0) hz
  convert hd.continuousAt_div using 1
  funext p
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp [powerLog]
  · simp [powerLog, hp]
records.comment:
The normalized power response really tends to the logarithm as its exponent
tends to zero, including the explicitly defined value at zero.

records.statement:
theorem tendsto_powerLog_exponent_zero {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    Tendsto (fun p => powerLog p z) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (log z))
records.proof:
by
  simpa using (continuousAt_powerLog_exponent_zero hz).tendsto

records.statement:
@[simp] theorem powerLogDensity_zero (K κ₀ κ : ℝ) :
    powerLogDensity 0 K κ₀ κ = K * (κ * log (κ / κ₀) - κ + κ₀)
records.proof:
by
  simp [powerLogDensity]

records.statement:
@[simp] theorem powerLogDensity_neg_one (K κ₀ κ : ℝ) :
    powerLogDensity (-1) K κ₀ κ = K * (κ - κ₀ - κ₀ * log (κ / κ₀))
records.proof:
by
  norm_num [powerLogDensity]

records.statement:
theorem powerLogDensity_reference (p K : ℝ) {κ₀ : ℝ} (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) :
    powerLogDensity p K κ₀ κ₀ = 0
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [powerLogDensity, hp, hκ₀.ne']
  · by_cases hp' : p = -1 <;> simp [powerLogDensity, hp, hp', hκ₀.ne']

by
  unfold powerLogDensity
  have hz : 0 < κ / κ₀ := div_pos hκ hκ₀
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp only [powerLog_zero]
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id κ).mul (hasDerivAt_log_ratio hκ₀ hκ)).sub
      (hasDerivAt_id κ)).add_const κ₀).const_mul K using 1
    all_goals dsimp
    field_simp; ring
  · by_cases hp' : p = -1
    · subst p
      simp only [show (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num, ite_false]
      convert (((hasDerivAt_id κ).sub_const κ₀).sub
        ((hasDerivAt_log_ratio hκ₀ hκ).const_mul κ₀)).const_mul K using 1
      all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [powerLog, ite_eq_right hp, Real.rpow_neg_one, inv_div]; ring)
    · have hp1 : p + 1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hp'; linarith
      simp only [hp, hp', ite_false, powerLog]
      have hd := ((((hasDerivAt_id κ).div_const κ₀).rpow_const
        (p := p + 1) (Or.inl hz.ne')).sub_const 1).div_const (p + 1)
      convert (hd.sub (((hasDerivAt_id κ).div_const κ₀).sub_const 1)).const_mul
        (K * κ₀ / p) using 1
      all_goals dsimp
      rw [show p + 1 - 1 = p by ring]
      field_simp
records.comment:
Actual differentiation of the displayed potential, including both exceptional
exponents.  The response formula is proved, not supplied as a hypothesis.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_powerLogDensity (p K : ℝ) {κ₀ κ : ℝ}
    (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (powerLogDensity p K κ₀))
      (K / κ₀ * (κ / κ₀) ^ (p - 1)) κ
records.proof:
by
  have he : deriv (powerLogDensity p K κ₀) =ᶠ[𝓝 κ]
      fun q => K * powerLog p (q / κ₀) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds hκ] with q hq
    exact (hasDerivAt_powerLogDensity p K hκ₀ hq).deriv
  have hd := ((hasDerivAt_powerLog (p := p) (div_pos hκ hκ₀)).comp κ
    ((hasDerivAt_id κ).div_const κ₀)).const_mul K
  have hd' : HasDerivAt (fun q => K * powerLog p (q / κ₀))
      (K / κ₀ * (κ / κ₀) ^ (p - 1)) κ := by
    convert hd using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | ring
  exact hd'.congr_of_eventuallyEq he
records.comment:
The actual second derivative of the potential remains positive for every
real response exponent when the reference curvature and scale are positive.

records.proof:
by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_deriv_powerLogDensity p K hκ₀ hκ).deriv]
  exact mul_pos (div_pos hK hκ₀) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (div_pos hκ hκ₀) _)

records.statement:
theorem powerLogDensity_one (K : ℝ) {κ₀ : ℝ} (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (κ : ℝ) :
    powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀ κ = (K / κ₀) * κ ^ 2 / 2 - K * κ + K * κ₀ / 2
records.proof:
by
  norm_num [powerLogDensity, Real.rpow_two]
  field_simp; ring
records.comment:
Exponent one recovers a classical quadratic density plus an affine term.
This polynomial identity extends to all signed curvatures.

records.statement:
theorem energy_powerLogDensity_one {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (K : ℝ) {κ₀ : ℝ} (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ =
      energy (fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ -
        K * (θ ℓ - θ 0) + K * κ₀ / 2 * ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have he : powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀ =
      fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2 + (-K) * q + K * κ₀ / 2 := by
    funext q
    rw [powerLogDensity_one K hκ₀]
    ring
  rw [he, energy_affine_density (by fun_prop) hθ]
  ring
records.comment:
The affine part changes the actual curve energy only by the fixed lifted
endpoint angles and length, using the existing affine-density integral theorem.

records.statement:
theorem energy_powerLogDensity_one_le_iff {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (K : ℝ) {κ₀ : ℝ} (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (h0 : θ 0 = ψ 0) (hend : θ ℓ = ψ ℓ) :
    energy (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ ≤ energy (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) ψ ℓ ↔
      energy (fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ ≤
        energy (fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) ψ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_powerLogDensity_one hθ K hκ₀,
    energy_powerLogDensity_one hψ K hκ₀, h0, hend]
  exact add_le_add_iff_right _ |>.trans (sub_le_sub_iff_right _)
records.comment:
On fixed endpoint-angle data, exponent one compares curves in exactly the
same order as the classical quadratic bending energy.

records.statement:
theorem angle_sub_eq_initial_of_curvature_eq {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, ψ s - θ s = ψ 0 - θ 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => ψ t - θ t) 0 s := by
    intro s hs
    have hk : deriv ψ s = deriv θ s := hκ s hs
    convert ((hψ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.sub
      (hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt) using 1
    simp only [hk, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := isOpen_Ioo.exists_is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
    (convex_Ioo (0 : ℝ) ℓ).isPreconnected
    (fun s hs => (hd s hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun s hs => (hd s hs).deriv)
  have hcc : EqOn (fun s => ψ s - θ s) (fun _ => c) (Icc 0 ℓ) := by
    have heq : EqOn (fun s => ψ s - θ s) (fun _ => c) (Ioo 0 ℓ) := hc
    simpa only [closure_Ioo hℓ.ne] using
      heq.closure (hψ.continuous.sub hθ.continuous) continuous_const
  intro s hs
  exact (hcc hs).trans (hcc ⟨le_rfl, hℓ.le⟩).symm
records.comment:
Equal signed curvature on the interior fixes the difference of tangent angles
throughout the closed interval, including both endpoints.

records.statement:
theorem angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (h₀ : ψ 0 = θ 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, ψ s = θ s
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs
  have h := angle_sub_eq_initial_of_curvature_eq hℓ hθ hψ hκ s hs
  rw [h₀, sub_self] at h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
records.comment: Initial real angle plus the curvature function determines the angle lift.

records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord
  refine congrArg (fun z : ℝ => x₀ + z) (intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_)
  intro t ht
  rw [uIcc_of_le hs.1] at ht
  change cos (ψ t) = cos (θ t)
  rw [h ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hs.2⟩]
records.comment: The coordinate reconstruction only reads the angle on its integration interval.

records.proof:
by
  unfold yCoord
  refine congrArg (fun z : ℝ => y₀ + z) (intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_)
  intro t ht
  rw [uIcc_of_le hs.1] at ht
  change sin (ψ t) = sin (θ t)
  rw [h ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hs.2⟩]

records.statement:
theorem reconstruction_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (h₀ : ψ 0 = θ 0) (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      xCoord ψ x₀ s = xCoord θ x₀ s ∧ yCoord ψ y₀ s = yCoord θ y₀ s
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs
  have ha := angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial hℓ hθ hψ hκ h₀
  exact ⟨xCoord_eq_of_angle_eq ha hs x₀, yCoord_eq_of_angle_eq ha hs y₀⟩
records.comment: Fixed initial point and initial real angle remove the remaining freedom.

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_add_angle {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (α x₀ y₀ x₁ s : ℝ) :
    xCoord (fun u => θ u + α) x₁ s - x₁ =
      cos α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) - sin α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀)
records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord yCoord
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, cos_add]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    (f := fun u => cos (θ u) * cos α) (g := fun u => sin (θ u) * sin α)
    (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := s)
    (((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 s)
    (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 s),
    intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  ring
records.comment: Adding a constant angle rotates the displacement through that angle.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_add_angle {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (α x₀ y₀ y₁ s : ℝ) :
    yCoord (fun u => θ u + α) y₁ s - y₁ =
      sin α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) + cos α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀)
records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord yCoord
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, sin_add]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
    (f := fun u => sin (θ u) * cos α) (g := fun u => cos (θ u) * sin α)
    (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := s)
    (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 s)
    (((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 s),
    intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  ring

records.statement:
theorem reconstruction_rotation_of_curvature_eq {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ α : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (hα : α = ψ 0 - θ 0) (x₀ y₀ x₁ y₁ : ℝ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      xCoord ψ x₁ s - x₁ =
        cos α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) - sin α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀) ∧
      yCoord ψ y₁ s - y₁ =
        sin α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) + cos α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀)
records.proof:
by
  have ha : EqOn ψ (fun s => θ s + α) (Icc 0 ℓ) := by
    intro s hs
    have h := angle_sub_eq_initial_of_curvature_eq hℓ hθ hψ hκ s hs
    rw [← hα] at h
    linarith
  intro s hs
  rw [xCoord_eq_of_angle_eq ha hs x₁, yCoord_eq_of_angle_eq ha hs y₁]
  exact ⟨xCoord_add_angle hθ.continuous α x₀ y₀ x₁ s,
    yCoord_add_angle hθ.continuous α x₀ y₀ y₁ s⟩
records.comment:
Equal signed curvature gives an explicit orientation-preserving rigid motion.
Here α is exactly the difference of the two chosen initial angle lifts.

records.statement:
theorem energy_eq_of_curvature_eq {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s) (ε : ℝ → ℝ) :
    energy ε ψ ℓ = energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have hcc : EqOn (deriv ψ) (deriv θ) (Icc 0 ℓ) := by
    have heq : EqOn (deriv ψ) (deriv θ) (Ioo 0 ℓ) := hκ
    simpa only [closure_Ioo hℓ.ne] using
      heq.closure hψ.continuous_deriv_one hθ.continuous_deriv_one
  unfold energy
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s hs
  rw [uIcc_of_le hℓ.le] at hs
  change ε (deriv ψ s) = ε (deriv θ s)
  rw [hcc hs]
records.comment:
Since the density reads only signed curvature, equal curvature gives equal energy.
No evenness, convexity, or regularity assumption on the density is needed here.

records.statement:
theorem middle_replacement_boundary_and_weight_ratio
    {ε θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ))
    (hx : (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s))
    (hy : (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s))
    (β x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    (θ 0 = φ 0 ∧ θ ℓ = φ ℓ ∧
      xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = xCoord φ x₀ ℓ ∧ yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = yCoord φ y₀ ℓ) ∧
    exponentialWeight β ε φ ℓ / exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ =
      exp (-β * ((∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) -
        (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s))))
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨boundary_eq_of_middle_integrals hθ.continuous hφ.continuous
    ha hab hb hleft hright hx hy x₀ y₀, ?_⟩
  have henergy := energy_sub_eq_middle_of_outer_angle_eq
    hε hθ hφ ha hab hb hleft hright
  rw [exponentialWeight, exponentialWeight, ← exp_sub, ← mul_sub, henergy]
records.comment:
The original boundary data are preserved, and the ratio of whole-curve
weights depends only on the middle energy difference. No sign on `β` or on the
energy is needed for this identity.

records.statement:
theorem middle_energy_lt_iff_exponentialWeight_lt
    {ε θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ)) :
    (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) < (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s)) ↔
      exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ < exponentialWeight β ε φ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have henergy := energy_sub_eq_middle_of_outer_angle_eq
    hε hθ hφ ha hab hb hleft hright
  rw [← energy_lt_iff_exponentialWeight_lt hβ]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
records.comment:
With the exterior fixed, strict improvement of the middle energy is
equivalent to strict increase of the whole-curve weight. Feasibility follows
from the preceding theorem when the two middle displacements also match.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_middle_replacement_comparison
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ →
      EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a) → EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ) →
      (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s)) →
      (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s)) →
      (∀ s ∈ Icc a b, |φ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv φ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
      (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s)) ≤ (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) ∧
        exponentialWeight β ε φ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hminimal⟩ := hmin
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ hleft hright hx hy hclose
  obtain ⟨hzero, hend, hxglobal, hyglobal⟩ := boundary_eq_of_middle_integrals
    hθ.continuous hφ.continuous ha hab hb hleft hright hx hy 0 0
  have hcos : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (φ s)) = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) := by
    simpa only [xCoord, zero_add] using hxglobal.symm
  have hsin : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (φ s)) = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s) := by
    simpa only [yCoord, zero_add] using hyglobal.symm
  have he := hminimal φ hφ hzero.symm hend.symm hcos hsin
    (C1_close_of_middle_close hθ hφ hr hleft hright hclose)
  have henergy := energy_sub_eq_middle_of_outer_angle_eq
    hε hθ hφ ha hab hb hleft hright
  exact ⟨by linarith, (energy_le_iff_exponentialWeight_le hβ ε θ φ ℓ).mp he⟩
records.comment:
A whole-curve C¹ local minimum cannot be improved by sufficiently small
smooth middle replacements preserving middle displacement. Only middle C¹
closeness is required: exterior derivative agreement and all global endpoint
conditions are derived. The same replacement cannot increase the whole weight.

records.statement:
theorem not_locallyMinimizing_of_arbitrarily_close_middle_improvements
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (himprove : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a) ∧ EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ) ∧
      (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s)) ∧
      (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s)) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Icc a b, |φ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv φ s - deriv θ s| < r) ∧
      (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) < (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s))) :
    ¬ LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  intro hmin
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcompare⟩ := locallyMinimizing_middle_replacement_comparison
    (β := 1) zero_lt_one hε hθ ha hab hb hmin
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hleft, hright, hx, hy, hclose, himproved⟩ := himprove r hr
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hcompare φ hφ hleft hright hx hy hclose).1) himproved
records.comment:
Arbitrarily small C¹ middle improvements exclude a constrained local
minimum of the whole curve. The hypothesis supplies actual globally smooth
replacements and their exact displacement matching, not just formal directions.

records.proof:
by
  by_contra h
  have hq : q < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h
  have hmax : IsLocalMax f x := isLocalMax_of_deriv_deriv_neg
    (by rw [hsecond.deriv]; exact hq) hmin.deriv_eq_zero hc
  have heq : f =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => f x := by
    filter_upwards [hmin, hmax] with y hy hy'
    exact le_antisymm hy' hy
  have hz : deriv (deriv f) x = 0 := by
    simpa using heq.deriv.deriv_eq
  rw [hsecond.deriv] at hz
  linarith
records.comment:
The second derivative of a continuous scalar function at a local minimum
is nonnegative, whenever that derivative exists.

records.proof: hθ.comp (contDiff_id.div_const a)
records.comment: Reparametrization by a constant scale preserves the stated smoothness.

records.proof:
by
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] using
    hθ.comp s ((hasDerivAt_id s).div_const a)
records.comment: Chain rule for the angle at the rescaled arc-length parameter.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_angle_scaling {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    (a s : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => θ (t / a)) s = deriv θ (s / a) / a
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_angle_scaling (hθ (s / a)).hasDerivAt).deriv

records.statement:
theorem curvature_angle_scaling {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    (a s : ℝ) :
    curvature (fun t => θ (t / a)) s = curvature θ (s / a) / a
records.proof: deriv_angle_scaling hθ a s
records.comment: Signed curvature scales by the reciprocal of a positive similarity.

records.statement:
theorem angle_scaling_endpoints (θ : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    (fun s => θ (s / a)) 0 = θ 0 ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  simp [ha.ne']
records.comment: The lifted initial and terminal tangent angles are unchanged.

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_scaling (θ : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (x₀ s : ℝ) :
    xCoord (fun t => θ (t / a)) (a * x₀) (a * s) = a * xCoord θ x₀ s
records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_div (fun t => Real.cos (θ t)) ha.ne']
  simp [ha.ne', smul_eq_mul, mul_add]
records.comment: The actual horizontal reconstruction is multiplied by the scale.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_scaling (θ : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (y₀ s : ℝ) :
    yCoord (fun t => θ (t / a)) (a * y₀) (a * s) = a * yCoord θ y₀ s
records.proof:
by
  unfold yCoord
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_div (fun t => Real.sin (θ t)) ha.ne']
  simp [ha.ne', smul_eq_mul, mul_add]
records.comment: The actual vertical reconstruction is multiplied by the scale.

records.statement:
theorem scaled_boundary_data {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a ℓ x₀ y₀ x₁ y₁ α β : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₁) (hy : yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = y₁)
    (hα : θ 0 = α) (hβ : θ ℓ = β) :
    0 < a * ℓ ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun s => θ (s / a)) ∧
      xCoord (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * x₀) (a * ℓ) = a * x₁ ∧
      yCoord (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * y₀) (a * ℓ) = a * y₁ ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) 0 = α ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = β
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨mul_pos ha hℓ, contDiff_angle_scaling hθ a, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [xCoord_scaling θ ha, hx]
  · rw [yCoord_scaling θ ha, hy]
  · simpa only [zero_div] using hα
  · simpa [ha.ne'] using hβ
records.comment:
A C¹ curve with prescribed boundary data yields a C¹ curve for the scaled
length and positions, with exactly the same real endpoint-angle lifts.

records.statement:
theorem energy_scaling {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      a * ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s / a)
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  simp_rw [deriv_angle_scaling hθ]
  simpa [ha.ne', smul_eq_mul] using
    (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_div (fun s => ε (deriv θ s / a))
      (a := 0) (b := a * ℓ) ha.ne')
records.comment:
General density transformation, obtained from the chain rule and change of
variables in the actual interval integral.  No homogeneity is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem energy_scaling_of_density_factor {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = (a * c) * energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_scaling hθ ha]
  simp_rw [hε]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  simp only [energy, mul_assoc]
records.comment:
A density multiplier at the chosen scale induces the energy multiplier
`a * c`.  The density hypothesis is separate from the general scaling identity.

records.statement:
theorem energy_scaling_of_homogeneous {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hε : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ q : ℝ, ε (t * q) = t ^ m * ε q) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = a ^ (1 - m) * energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have hf : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = (a⁻¹) ^ m * ε q := by
    intro q
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm q] using hε a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha) q
  rw [energy_scaling_of_density_factor hθ ha hf ℓ]
  rw [Real.inv_rpow ha.le m, Real.rpow_sub ha 1 m, Real.rpow_one]
  rfl
records.comment:
A density homogeneous of real degree `m` under positive scaling gives the
energy law `a^(1-m)`.  Homogeneity is an additional hypothesis, not a consequence
of the general smooth-density definition.

records.statement:
theorem energy_scaling_quadratic {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (k ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      energy (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ / a
records.proof:
by
  have hf : ∀ q : ℝ, k * (q / a) ^ 2 / 2 = (a⁻¹) ^ 2 * (k * q ^ 2 / 2) := by
    intro q
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]
    ring
  rw [energy_scaling_of_density_factor hθ ha hf ℓ]
  field_simp
records.comment:
The classical quadratic curvature density has reciprocal energy scaling.
The identity holds for every coefficient `k`; positivity is not needed here.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_scaling_of_density_factor {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a c ℓ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hmin⟩ := hmin
  let δ := r / (a + 1)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hr (by linarith)
  have hδr : δ < r := (div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < a + 1)).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have haδr : a * δ < r := by
    have he : δ * (a + 1) = r := div_mul_cancel₀ r (by linarith : a + 1 ≠ 0)
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro ψ hψ hψ0 hψℓ hx hy hclose
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ψ (s / a⁻¹)
  have hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ := contDiff_angle_scaling hψ a⁻¹
  have hround : (fun s => φ (s / a)) = ψ := by
    funext s
    simp [φ, ha.ne']
  have hθdiff := hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hφdiff := hφ.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hφ0 : φ 0 = θ 0 := by simpa [φ] using hψ0
  have hφℓ : φ ℓ = θ ℓ := by
    have hal : a * ℓ / a = ℓ := by field_simp
    simp only [hal] at hψℓ
    simpa [φ, div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hψℓ
  have hφx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (φ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) := by
    have heφ := xCoord_scaling φ ha 0 ℓ
    have heθ := xCoord_scaling θ ha 0 ℓ
    simp only [xCoord, mul_zero, zero_add] at heφ heθ
    simp_rw [show ∀ s, φ (s / a) = ψ s from congrFun hround] at heφ
    rw [heφ, heθ] at hx
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ ha.ne') hx
  have hφy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (φ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) := by
    have heφ := yCoord_scaling φ ha 0 ℓ
    have heθ := yCoord_scaling θ ha 0 ℓ
    simp only [yCoord, mul_zero, zero_add] at heφ heθ
    simp_rw [show ∀ s, φ (s / a) = ψ s from congrFun hround] at heφ
    rw [heφ, heθ] at hy
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ ha.ne') hy
  have hφclose : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      |φ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv φ s - deriv θ s| < r := by
    intro s hs
    have has : a * s ∈ Icc 0 (a * ℓ) :=
      ⟨mul_nonneg ha.le hs.1, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 ha.le⟩
    obtain ⟨hval, hder⟩ := hclose (a * s) has
    have hsa : a * s / a = s := by field_simp
    simp only [hsa] at hval
    constructor
    · have hv : |φ s - θ s| < δ := by
        simpa [φ, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hval
      exact hv.trans hδr
    · rw [deriv_angle_scaling hθdiff, hsa] at hder
      have hdφ : deriv φ s = a * deriv ψ (a * s) := by
        rw [show φ = (fun s => ψ (s / a⁻¹)) from rfl,
          deriv_angle_scaling (hψ.differentiable one_ne_zero)]
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
      have hd : deriv φ s - deriv θ s =
          a * (deriv ψ (a * s) - deriv θ s / a) := by
        rw [hdφ]
        field_simp
      rw [hd, abs_mul, abs_of_pos ha]
      exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hder ha).trans haδr
  have he := hmin φ hφ hφ0 hφℓ hφx hφy hφclose
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (mul_pos ha hc).le
  rw [← energy_scaling_of_density_factor hθdiff ha hε ℓ,
    ← energy_scaling_of_density_factor hφdiff ha hε ℓ, hround] at hscaled
  exact hscaled
records.comment:
A positive density multiplier transports a C¹ constrained local minimum.
The proof pulls every nearby scaled competitor back to the original interval.
If the original radius is `r`, the scaled radius `r / (a + 1)` suffices.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_of_density_factor {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a c ℓ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) ↔
      LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hmin
    have hi : ∀ q, ε (q / a⁻¹) = c⁻¹ * ε q := by
      intro q
      have he : ε q = c * ε (q / a⁻¹) := by
        simpa [div_div, ha.ne'] using hε (q / a⁻¹)
      calc
        ε (q / a⁻¹) = c⁻¹ * (c * ε (q / a⁻¹)) := by simp [hc.ne']
        _ = c⁻¹ * ε q := by rw [← he]
    have hm := locallyMinimizing_scaling_of_density_factor
      (inv_pos.mpr ha) (inv_pos.mpr hc) (contDiff_angle_scaling hθ a) hi hmin
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, ha.ne', mul_assoc] using hm
  · exact locallyMinimizing_scaling_of_density_factor ha hc hθ hε
records.comment:
Positive similarity is reversible on the actual constrained C¹ local-minimum
property, including its neighborhood and all endpoint constraints.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_of_homogeneous {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a m ℓ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hε : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ q : ℝ, ε (t * q) = t ^ m * ε q) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) ↔
      LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  apply locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_of_density_factor ha
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha) m) hθ
  intro q
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm q] using hε a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha) q
records.comment:
Real-degree homogeneous densities transport local minima under every
positive similarity. The degree may be arbitrary: the energy multiplier is
positive even when the energy itself is not.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_quadratic {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a ℓ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (k : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) ↔
      LocallyMinimizing (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  apply locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_of_density_factor ha
    (sq_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha)) hθ
  intro q
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]
  ring
records.comment:
In particular the classical quadratic density has equivalent constrained
local-minimum problems at positively scaled boundary data.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_scaling_of_density_factor {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q) (β ℓ : ℝ) :
    exponentialWeight β ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      exponentialWeight (β * (a * c)) ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  unfold exponentialWeight
  rw [energy_scaling_of_density_factor hθ ha hε ℓ]
  congr 1
  ring
records.comment:
The scale factor in energy can be absorbed into the weight parameter.
No probabilistic interpretation of the exponential weight is required.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_scaling_rescaled_parameter {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q) (β ℓ : ℝ) :
    exponentialWeight (β / (a * c)) ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [exponentialWeight_scaling_of_density_factor hθ ha hε]
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (mul_ne_zero ha.ne' hc)]
records.comment:
Changing the weight parameter by the reciprocal of the positive energy
scale preserves the numerical weight of each curve.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation {ε κ v w : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε) (hκ : Continuous κ)
    (hv : Continuous v) (hw : Continuous w) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (κ s + t * v s) * w s)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (κ s + t₀ * v s) * v s * w s) t₀
records.proof:
by
  have hεd : Differentiable ℝ ε := hε.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hε' : Continuous (deriv ε) := hε.continuous_deriv_one
  have hc : Continuous
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv ε (κ p.2 + p.1 * v p.2) * v p.2 * w p.2) :=
    ((hε'.comp ((hκ.comp continuous_snd).add
      (continuous_fst.mul (hv.comp continuous_snd)))).mul
      (hv.comp continuous_snd)).mul (hw.comp continuous_snd)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1))).prod
      (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
  have hmeas (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s => ε (κ s + t * v s) * w s) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    ((hε.continuous.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).mul hw).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hint : Integrable (fun s => ε (κ s + t₀ * v s) * w s)
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    (((hε.continuous.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).mul hw).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ).1
  have hmeas' : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s => deriv ε (κ s + t₀ * v s) * v s * w s)
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    (((hε'.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).mul hv).mul hw).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ),
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ‖deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s * w s‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with s hs
    intro t ht
    exact hC (t, s) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩, ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ), ∀ t ∈ Ioo (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1),
      HasDerivAt (fun t => ε (κ s + t * v s) * w s)
        (deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s * w s) t := by
    filter_upwards [] with s
    intro t _
    convert ((hεd (κ s + t * v s)).hasDerivAt.comp t
      (((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (v s)).const_add (κ s))).mul_const (w s) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | ring
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith : t₀ - 1 < t₀) (by linarith : t₀ < t₀ + 1))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hmeas) hint hmeas' hbound
    (integrable_const C) hdiff
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hℓ] using h.2
records.comment:
A weighted form of differentiation under the curvature integral, valid at
every real parameter value. The weight does not depend on that parameter.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_variation_at {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u => energy ε (angleVariation θ η u) ℓ)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s + t * deriv η s) * deriv η s) t
records.proof:
by
  have h := hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (w := fun _ => 1) hℓ hε
    hθ.continuous_deriv_one hη.continuous_deriv_one continuous_const t
  simpa only [mul_one, energy,
    deriv_angleVariation (hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero) (hη.differentiable one_ne_zero)] using h
records.comment: The first derivative of the actual energy at every variation parameter.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_energy_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s) ^ 2) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd : deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) =
      fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s + t * deriv η s) * deriv η s := by
    funext t
    exact (hasDerivAt_energy_variation_at hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ hη t).deriv
  rw [hd]
  have h := hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (ε := deriv ε)
    (κ := deriv θ) (v := deriv η) (w := deriv η) hℓ hε.deriv'
    hθ.continuous_deriv_one hη.continuous_deriv_one hη.continuous_deriv_one 0
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero, mul_assoc, ← pow_two] using h
records.comment:
Differentiate the already identified first derivative of the actual energy.
Its second variation is the curvature-density second derivative times `(η')²`.

records.statement:
theorem secondVariation_energy {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) :
    deriv (deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)) 0 =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s) ^ 2
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_deriv_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη).deriv
records.comment: The actual second derivative, rather than a separately defined quadratic form.

records.statement:
theorem mixedVariation_energy {ε θ η ξ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (hξ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ξ) :
    deriv (fun t => deriv
      (fun u => energy ε (angleVariation (angleVariation θ η t) ξ u) ℓ) 0) 0 =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * deriv η s * deriv ξ s
records.proof:
by
  have hd (t : ℝ) :
      deriv (fun u => energy ε (angleVariation (angleVariation θ η t) ξ u) ℓ) 0 =
        ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s + t * deriv η s) * deriv ξ s := by
    have ht : ContDiff ℝ 1 (angleVariation θ η t) :=
      hθ.add (contDiff_const.mul hη)
    simpa only [deriv_angleVariation (hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero)
      (hη.differentiable one_ne_zero)] using
      (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) ht hξ).deriv
  simp_rw [hd]
  have h := hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (ε := deriv ε)
    (κ := deriv θ) (v := deriv η) (w := deriv ξ) hℓ hε.deriv'
    hθ.continuous_deriv_one hη.continuous_deriv_one hξ.continuous_deriv_one 0
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero] using h.deriv
records.comment: The actual mixed derivative for the two angle directions `η` and `ξ`.

records.statement:
theorem mixedVariation_energy_symmetric {ε θ η ξ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (hξ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ξ) :
    deriv (fun t => deriv
      (fun u => energy ε (angleVariation (angleVariation θ η t) ξ u) ℓ) 0) 0 =
    deriv (fun u => deriv
      (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation (angleVariation θ ξ u) η t) ℓ) 0) 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [mixedVariation_energy hℓ hε hθ hη hξ, mixedVariation_energy hℓ hε hθ hξ hη]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s _
  dsimp
  ring
records.comment: Interchanging the two angle-variation directions preserves the mixed derivative.

records.statement:
theorem exists_multipliers_of_kernel
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (f c₁ c₂ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (h : ∀ v, c₁ v = 0 → c₂ v = 0 → f v = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ v, f v + lam * c₁ v + μ * c₂ v = 0
records.proof:
by
  let c : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := c₁.prod c₂
  have hf : f ∈ (LinearMap.ker c).dualAnnihilator := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
    intro v hv
    have hv' : c v = 0 := hv
    exact h v (congrArg Prod.fst hv') (congrArg Prod.snd hv')
  rw [← LinearMap.range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker] at hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨-g (1, 0), -g (0, 1), ?_⟩
  intro v
  have hgv : g (c v) = f v := DFunLike.congr_fun hg v
  have hc : c v = (c₁ v) • (1, 0) + (c₂ v) • (0, 1) := by
    ext <;> simp [c]
  rw [hc, map_add, map_smul, map_smul] at hgv
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hgv
  nlinarith
records.comment:
Vanishing on the kernel of two linear constraints gives two multipliers.
No rank or independence assumption is needed for this implication.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_multipliers {ℓ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hM : Continuous M)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) +
      lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
      μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  exact exists_multipliers_of_kernel (firstVariationLinear ℓ M hM)
    (constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => -sin (θ s)) (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).neg)
    (constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => cos (θ s)) (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ)) hstat
records.comment: The multiplier theorem for the actual elastica integral functionals.

records.statement:
theorem residual_zero_of_weighted_square_integral {ℓ : ℝ} {r : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hint : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, s * (ℓ - s) * (r s) ^ 2) = 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, r s = 0
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs
  by_contra hne
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => t * (ℓ - t) * (r t) ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ t in 0..ℓ, t * (ℓ - t) * (r t) ^ 2 := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_lt_integral_of_continuousOn_of_le_of_exists_lt
      hℓ continuousOn_const hcont.continuousOn
      (fun t ht => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht.1.le (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)) (sq_nonneg _))
      ⟨s, ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩, mul_pos (mul_pos hs.1 (sub_pos.mpr hs.2)) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hne)⟩
    simpa using h
  linarith
records.comment: Weighted square form of the fundamental lemma, with explicit positivity.

records.statement:
theorem firstVariation_by_parts {ℓ : ℝ} {M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M) (η : variationSpace ℓ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) =
      -(∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv M s * η.val s)
records.proof:
by
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
    (fun s _ => (hM.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt)
    (fun s _ => (η.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt)
    (hM.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
    (η.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
  simpa [η.property.2.1, η.property.2.2] using h
records.comment: Integration by parts with the two fixed-end boundary terms removed.

records.statement:
theorem augmented_integral_eq_residual {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M) (hq : Continuous q) (η : variationSpace ℓ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, (-deriv M s + q s) * η.val s
records.proof:
by
  rw [firstVariation_by_parts hM η]
  simp_rw [add_mul, neg_mul]
  have he := intervalIntegral.integral_add
    (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := ℓ)
    (f := fun s => -(deriv M s * η.val s)) (g := fun s => q s * η.val s)
    ((hM.continuous_deriv_one.mul η.property.1.continuous).neg.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    ((hq.mul η.property.1.continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _)
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] using he.symm
records.comment: Combining the two terms of a first variation into its Euler residual.

records.statement:
theorem residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = q s
records.proof:
by
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => -deriv M s + q s
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ 1 r := (hM.deriv').neg.add hq
  let η : variationSpace ℓ :=
    ⟨fun s => s * (ℓ - s) * r s,
      ⟨(contDiff_id.mul (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)).mul hr, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
  have hint := hstat η
  rw [augmented_integral_eq_residual (hM.of_le (by norm_num)) hq.continuous η] at hint
  have hint' : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, s * (ℓ - s) * (r s) ^ 2) = 0 := by
    convert hint using 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    change s * (ℓ - s) * (r s) ^ 2 = r s * (s * (ℓ - s) * r s)
    ring
  have hz := residual_zero_of_weighted_square_integral hℓ hr.continuous hint'
  intro s hs
  have := hz s hs
  dsimp [r] at this
  linarith
records.comment:
The residual-derived test function is C¹ and has zero endpoint values.
This is the step that keeps the fundamental lemma within the stated variation family.

records.statement:
theorem augmented_stationary_of_residual_zero {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M) (hq : Continuous q)
    (hEL : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = q s) :
    ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  have hcc : EqOn (deriv M) q (Icc 0 ℓ) := by
    have hh : EqOn (deriv M) q (Ioo 0 ℓ) := hEL
    have hc := hh.closure hM.continuous_deriv_one hq
    simpa only [closure_Ioo hℓ.ne] using hc
  intro η
  rw [augmented_integral_eq_residual hM hq η]
  calc
    _ = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, (0 : ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [uIcc_of_le hℓ.le] at hs
      change (-deriv M s + q s) * η.val s = 0
      rw [hcc hs]
      ring
    _ = 0 := by simp
records.comment:
The converse integration-by-parts implication needs only C¹ for M.
Equality on the interior extends to the endpoints by continuity.

records.statement:
theorem augmented_stationary_iff_residual_zero {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q) :
    (∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0) ↔
      ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = q s
records.proof:
⟨residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary hℓ hM hq,
    augmented_stationary_of_residual_zero hℓ (hM.of_le (by norm_num)) hq.continuous⟩
records.comment: For this smoothness class the integral condition and angle residual are equivalent.

records.statement:
theorem force_integral {ℓ lam μ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (η : variationSpace ℓ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) * η.val s) =
      lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
      μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s)
records.proof:
by
  have hi₁ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => lam * (-sin (θ s) * η.val s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul ((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).neg.mul η.property.1.continuous)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hi₂ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => μ * (cos (θ s) * η.val s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul ((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).mul η.property.1.continuous)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  calc
    _ = ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
        lam * (-sin (θ s) * η.val s) + μ * (cos (θ s) * η.val s) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hi₁ hi₂,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
records.comment: The integrated force term is the linear combination of endpoint constraints.

records.statement:
theorem angleEquation_of_stationary {ℓ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv M s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, hm⟩ := stationary_multipliers hθ.continuous hM.continuous hstat
  refine ⟨lam, μ, residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary hℓ hM
    ((contDiff_const.mul hθ.sin).add (contDiff_const.mul hθ.cos)) ?_⟩
  intro η
  rw [force_integral hθ.continuous η]
  linarith [hm η]
records.comment: Concrete constrained stationarity implies the classical angle equation.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_of_angleEquation {ℓ lam μ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M)
    (hEL : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) :
    ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  have hq : Continuous (fun s => -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) :=
    (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ)).add
      (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ))
  intro η hx hy
  have h := augmented_stationary_of_residual_zero hℓ hM hq hEL η
  rw [force_integral hθ η, hx, hy] at h
  simpa using h
records.comment: A solution of the angle equation is stationary under the linearized constraints.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_iff_exists_angleEquation {ℓ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M) :
    (∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0) ↔
    (∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv M s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s))
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · exact angleEquation_of_stationary hℓ hθ hM
  · rintro ⟨lam, μ, hEL⟩
    exact stationary_of_angleEquation hℓ hθ.continuous (hM.of_le (by norm_num)) hEL
records.comment:
Full equivalence with the linearized fixed-position constraints.
It says neither that a stationary curve minimizes energy nor that admissible
curves exist for arbitrary boundary data.

records.statement:
theorem cos_eq_one_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, cos (θ s) = 1
records.proof:
by
  have hi : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) = ℓ := by
    unfold xCoord at hx
    linarith
  intro s hs
  by_contra hne
  have hp : cos (θ s) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (cos_le_one _) hne
  have hlt := intervalIntegral.integral_lt_integral_of_continuousOn_of_le_of_exists_lt
    hℓ (continuous_cos.comp hθ).continuousOn continuousOn_const
    (fun t _ => cos_le_one (θ t)) ⟨s, hs, hp⟩
  have : (∫ t in 0..ℓ, cos (θ t)) < ℓ := by simpa using hlt
  linarith
records.comment:
Saturation of the horizontal displacement bound forces the horizontal
tangent component to be one, including at the endpoints.

records.statement:
theorem sin_eq_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, sin (θ s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs
  have hc := cos_eq_one_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ hx s hs
  have hh := sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ s)
  rw [hc] at hh
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (sin (θ s))]
records.comment: The vertical tangent component vanishes under the same saturated constraint.

records.statement:
theorem curvature_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, curvature θ s = 0
records.proof:
by
  have hc := cos_eq_one_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ.continuous hx
  have hs := sin_eq_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ.continuous hx
  have hd : EqOn (deriv θ) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (Ioo 0 ℓ) := by
    intro s hsi
    have he : (fun t => sin (θ t)) =ᶠ[𝓝 s] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hsi] with t ht
      exact hs t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩
    have hh := ((hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.sin).deriv
    rw [he.deriv_eq, deriv_const, hc s ⟨hsi.1.le, hsi.2.le⟩, one_mul] at hh
    exact hh.symm
  have hclosed := hd.closure hθ.continuous_deriv_one continuous_const
  simpa only [curvature, closure_Ioo hℓ.ne, Set.EqOn] using hclosed
records.comment: For C¹ angles, the signed curvature also vanishes on the closed interval.

records.statement:
theorem angle_eq_initial_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0
records.proof:
by
  apply angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial (θ := fun _ => θ 0) hℓ contDiff_const hθ
  · intro s hs
    simpa using curvature_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ hx s ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩
  · rfl
records.comment:
Fixing the initial real angle removes the possible multiples of 2π:
the whole lifted angle is exactly its initial value.

records.statement:
theorem energy_eq_straight_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) (ε : ℝ → ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ = ℓ * ε 0
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  have he : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)) = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε 0 := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le hℓ.le] at hs
    exact congrArg ε (curvature_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ hx s hs)
  rw [he]
  simp
records.comment:
Every exactly feasible curve for the saturated horizontal displacement has
the same energy, for any density; no sign assumption on its second derivative.

records.statement:
theorem straight_is_global_minimum_on_horizontal_constraint {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (ε : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hx : xCoord θ 0 ℓ = ℓ) :
    energy ε (fun _ => 0) ℓ ≤ energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_const, energy_eq_straight_of_xCoord_eq_length
    (x₀ := 0) hℓ hθ (by simpa using hx)]
records.comment:
In particular the straight curve is a global minimizer among all C¹ angles
with the saturated horizontal displacement, for every density. Adding the
fixed vertical endpoint and fixed end angles only restricts this feasible set.

records.statement:
theorem straight_polynomial_hasDerivAt (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u * (1 - u) * (u - 1 / 2))
      (-3 * s ^ 2 + 3 * s - 1 / 2) s
records.proof:
by
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id s).mul ((hasDerivAt_const s (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id s))).mul
    ((hasDerivAt_id s).sub_const (1 / 2))) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply]; ring)
records.comment: Derivative of the explicit fixed-end polynomial variation.

records.statement:
theorem straight_polynomial_integral :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) = 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd (s : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => -(u ^ 4) / 4 + u ^ 3 / 2 - u ^ 2 / 4)
        (s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) s := by
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 4).neg.div_const 4).add
      (((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 3).div_const 2)).sub
        (((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 2).div_const 4) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq]; norm_num; ring)
  have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) := by fun_prop
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (fun s _ => hd s) (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h
records.comment:
Its average is zero, hence it lies in the vertical linearized constraint
kernel at a horizontal straight curve.

records.statement:
theorem straight_polynomial_deriv_square_integral :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      (deriv (fun u : ℝ => u * (1 - u) * (u - 1 / 2)) s) ^ 2) = 1 / 20
records.proof:
by
  have hd (s : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => 9 * u ^ 5 / 5 - 9 * u ^ 4 / 2 +
        4 * u ^ 3 - 3 * u ^ 2 / 2 + u / 4)
        ((-3 * s ^ 2 + 3 * s - 1 / 2) ^ 2) s := by
    convert ((((((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 5).const_mul 9).div_const 5).sub
      ((((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 4).const_mul 9).div_const 2)).add
        (((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 3).const_mul 4)).sub
          ((((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 2).const_mul 3).div_const 2) |>.add
            ((hasDerivAt_id s).div_const 4) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq]; norm_num; ring)
  have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (-3 * s ^ 2 + 3 * s - 1 / 2) ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (fun s _ => hd s) (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  simp_rw [(straight_polynomial_hasDerivAt _).deriv]
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h
records.comment: Its derivative has strictly positive squared integral, evaluated exactly.

records.statement:
theorem negative_quadratic_second_deriv (q : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ 2) / 2)) q = -1
records.proof:
by
  have hd : deriv (fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ 2) / 2) = fun x => -x := by
    funext x
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => -(u ^ 2) / 2) (-x) x := by
      convert ((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2).neg.div_const 2 using 1
      all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq]; norm_num; ring)
    exact h.deriv
  rw [hd]
  exact (hasDerivAt_id q).neg.deriv

records.statement:
theorem straight_polynomial_variation_not_exactly_feasible {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    xCoord (angleVariation (fun _ => 0)
      (fun s : ℝ => s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) t) 0 1 < 1
records.proof:
by
  let θ : ℝ → ℝ := angleVariation (fun _ => 0)
    (fun s : ℝ => s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) t
  have hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := by
    change ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun s : ℝ => 0 + t * (s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)))
    fun_prop
  have hne : xCoord θ 0 1 ≠ 1 := by
    intro hx
    have ha := angle_eq_initial_of_xCoord_eq_length (ℓ := 1) (x₀ := 0)
      (by norm_num) hθ (by simpa using hx) (1 / 4) (by constructor <;> norm_num)
    norm_num [θ, angleVariation] at ha
    exact ht (by linarith)
  have habs := abs_x_displacement_le θ 0 1 (by norm_num)
  have hle : xCoord θ 0 1 ≤ 1 := by
    simpa using (le_abs_self (xCoord θ 0 1)).trans (by simpa using habs)
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
records.comment:
Although its first endpoint derivative is zero, every nonzero member of
this additive variation has strictly smaller horizontal displacement.

records.statement:
theorem straight_negative_secondVariation_counterexample :
    (∀ θ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 θ → xCoord θ 0 1 = 1 →
      energy (fun q : ℝ => -(q ^ 2) / 2) (fun _ => 0) 1 ≤
        energy (fun q : ℝ => -(q ^ 2) / 2) θ 1) ∧
    ∃ η : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η ∧ η 0 = 0 ∧ η 1 = 0 ∧
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..1, cos (t * η s)) 0 = 0 ∧
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..1, sin (t * η s)) 0 = 0 ∧
      deriv (deriv (fun t =>
        energy (fun q : ℝ => -(q ^ 2) / 2)
          (angleVariation (fun _ => 0) η t) 1)) 0 = -1 / 20
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun θ hθ hx => straight_is_global_minimum_on_horizontal_constraint
    (by norm_num) _ θ hθ hx, ?_⟩
  let η : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)
  have hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η := by dsimp [η]; fun_prop
  refine ⟨η, hη, by simp [η], by simp [η], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [zero_add, sin_zero, neg_zero, zero_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_zero] using
      (hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation (θ := fun _ => 0)
        (ℓ := 1) (by norm_num) continuous_const hη.continuous).deriv
  · have h := (hasDerivAt_vertical_variation (θ := fun _ => 0)
      (ℓ := 1) (by norm_num) continuous_const hη.continuous).deriv
    simpa only [zero_add, cos_zero, one_mul, η, straight_polynomial_integral] using h
  · rw [secondVariation_energy (by norm_num)
      (show ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun q : ℝ => -(q ^ 2) / 2) by fun_prop) contDiff_const hη]
    simp_rw [negative_quadratic_second_deriv]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have hi : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (deriv η s) ^ 2) = 1 / 20 :=
      straight_polynomial_deriv_square_integral
    rw [hi]
    norm_num
records.comment:
The straight curve is an exact constrained global minimizer, but this C¹
fixed-end direction belongs to both linearized endpoint kernels and has a
negative actual energy second derivative. The singular constraint is essential.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_angleVariation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    (hη : Differentiable ℝ η) (t s : ℝ) :
    deriv (angleVariation θ η t) s = deriv θ s + t * deriv η s
records.proof:
by
  exact ((hθ s).hasDerivAt.add ((hη s).hasDerivAt.const_mul t)).deriv
records.comment: Its curvature is the sum of the original curvature and the varied derivative.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_variation {ε κ v : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hv : Continuous v) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (κ s + t * v s))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (κ s) * v s) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hεd : Differentiable ℝ ε := hε.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hε' : Continuous (deriv ε) := hε.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv ε (κ p.2 + p.1 * v p.2) * v p.2) :=
    (hε'.comp ((hκ.comp continuous_snd).add
      (continuous_fst.mul (hv.comp continuous_snd)))).mul (hv.comp continuous_snd)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).prod
      (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
  have hmeas (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s => ε (κ s + t * v s)) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    (hε.continuous.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hint : Integrable (fun s => ε (κ s + (0 : ℝ) * v s))
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) := by
    exact ((hε.continuous.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ).1
  have hmeas' : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s => deriv ε (κ s + (0 : ℝ) * v s) * v s)
