      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    ((hε'.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).mul hv).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ),
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with s hs
    intro t ht
    exact hC (t, s) ⟨⟨le_of_lt ht.1, le_of_lt ht.2⟩, ⟨le_of_lt hs.1, hs.2⟩⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ), ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun t => ε (κ s + t * v s))
        (deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s) t := by
    filter_upwards [] with s
    intro t _
    convert (hεd (κ s + t * v s)).hasDerivAt.comp t
      (((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (v s)).const_add (κ s)) using 1
    all_goals first | (funext x; rfl) | ring
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (Ioo_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hmeas) hint hmeas' hbound
    (integrable_const C) hdiff
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hℓ, zero_mul, add_zero] using h.2
records.comment:
Differentiating a general density under a finite curvature integral.

The compact rectangle supplies the bound; boundedness of the density derivative
on all of ℝ is not assumed.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s) 0
records.proof:
by
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_variation hℓ hε
    (hθ.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)) (hη.continuous_deriv (by norm_num))
  simpa only [energy, deriv_angleVariation
    (hθ.differentiable (by norm_num)) (hη.differentiable (by norm_num))] using h
records.comment: First variation of the energy evaluated at the genuinely varied angle.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, Real.cos (θ s + t * η s))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -Real.sin (θ s) * η s) 0
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [Real.deriv_cos] using
    (hasDerivAt_integral_variation hℓ Real.contDiff_cos hθ hη)
records.comment: First variation of the horizontal displacement.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_vertical_variation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, Real.sin (θ s + t * η s))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, Real.cos (θ s) * η s) 0
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [Real.deriv_sin] using
    (hasDerivAt_integral_variation hℓ Real.contDiff_sin hθ hη)
records.comment: First variation of the vertical displacement.

records.statement:
theorem powerLog_zero_exponentialWeight (β : ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    powerLog 0 (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) = -β * energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [powerLog_zero, log_exponentialWeight]
records.comment: At exponent zero, the composed representation recovers the energy exactly.

records.statement:
theorem tendsto_powerLog_exponentialWeight_zero (β : ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun p => powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)) (𝓝 0)
      (𝓝 (-β * energy ε θ ℓ))
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [log_exponentialWeight] using
    tendsto_powerLog_exponent_zero (exponentialWeight_pos β ε θ ℓ)
records.comment:
The positive weight makes the existing exponent-zero limit applicable to
every energy value, regardless of the sign of the curvature or the density.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_powerLog_exp_neg_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x d : ℝ}
    (p β : ℝ) (hf : HasDerivAt f d x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => powerLog p (exp (-β * f t)))
      (-β * exp (-p * β * f x) * d) x
records.proof:
by
  have he : exp (-β * f x) ^ (p - 1) * exp (-β * f x) =
      exp (-p * β * f x) := by
    rw [rpow_def_of_pos (exp_pos _), log_exp, ← exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  convert (hasDerivAt_powerLog (p := p) (exp_pos (-β * f x))).comp x
    (hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf) using 1
  · rfl
  · calc
      -β * exp (-p * β * f x) * d =
          -β * (exp (-β * f x) ^ (p - 1) * exp (-β * f x)) * d := by rw [he]
      _ = _ := by ring
records.comment: Chain the two already proved derivatives and simplify the positive factor.

records.statement:
theorem strictAnti_powerLog_exp_neg_mul (p : ℝ) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    StrictAnti (fun x : ℝ => powerLog p (exp (-β * x)))
records.proof:
by
  apply strictAnti_of_deriv_neg
  intro x
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => powerLog p (exp (-β * t)))
      (-β * exp (-p * β * x) * 1) x := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using hasDerivAt_powerLog_exp_neg_mul p β (hasDerivAt_id x)
  rw [hd.deriv]
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos hβ) (exp_pos _)
records.comment: All real response exponents reverse energy order when β is positive.

records.statement:
theorem energy_le_iff_powerLog_exponentialWeight_le (p : ℝ) {β : ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ ≤ energy ε ψ ℓ ↔
      powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ) ≤
        powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  exact (strictAnti_powerLog_exp_neg_mul p hβ).le_iff_ge.symm
records.comment:
Exact comparison on the same curves, with no regularity requirement for
this order-theoretic identity.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_iff_powerLog_weight_local_maximum (p : ℝ) {β : ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
        ψ 0 = θ 0 → ψ ℓ = θ ℓ →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) →
        (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
          |ψ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv ψ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
        powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ) ≤
          powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  simp only [LocallyMinimizing, energy_le_iff_powerLog_exponentialWeight_le p hβ]
records.comment:
Compose with the existing constrained C¹ neighborhood, retaining all
endpoint data rather than replacing it by an unconstrained scalar problem.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_powerLog_weight_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (p β : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => powerLog p
      (exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ))
      (-β * exp (-p * β * energy ε θ ℓ) *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hzero : angleVariation θ η 0 = θ := by
    funext s
    simp only [angleVariation, zero_mul, add_zero]
  simpa only [exponentialWeight, hzero] using
    hasDerivAt_powerLog_exp_neg_mul p β (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη)
records.comment: Actual differentiation along the existing angle variation.

records.statement:
theorem powerLog_weight_variation_stationary_iff {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ β : ℝ}
    (hβ : β ≠ 0) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (p : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => powerLog p
      (exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)) 0 = 0 ↔
      deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) 0 = 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_powerLog_weight_variation hℓ hε hθ hη p β).deriv,
    (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη).deriv]
  simp only [mul_eq_zero, neg_eq_zero, hβ, exp_ne_zero, false_or]
records.comment: Vanishing of the actual first variation is unchanged for every exponent.

records.statement:
theorem powerLog_exponentialWeight_split {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (p β a ℓ : ℝ) :
    powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) =
      powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ a) +
      powerLog p (exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)))) +
      p * powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ a) *
        powerLog p (exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s))))
records.proof:
by
  rw [exponentialWeight_split hε hθ β a ℓ]
  exact powerLog_mul p (exponentialWeight_pos β ε θ a) (exp_pos _)
records.comment:
Interval composition transports through the already established product
identity for normalized powers; p=0 reduces to additive negative energy.

records.statement:
theorem scalar_gap (lam r a x : ℝ) :
    f lam r (input lam r a) x - f lam r (input lam r a) a =
      (x - a) ^ 2 * (lam / 4 * (x + a) ^ 2 + (lam * a ^ 2 + r) / 2)
records.proof:
by
  unfold f input
  ring

records.statement:
theorem energy_gap (lam r a x y : ℝ) :
    E lam r (input lam r a) x y - E lam r (input lam r a) a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) =
      (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2 +
        (x - a) ^ 2 * (lam / 4 * (x + a) ^ 2 + (lam * a ^ 2 + r) / 2)
records.proof:
by
  unfold E
  rw [sub_self, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_div, add_zero]
  linarith [scalar_gap lam r a x]

records.statement:
theorem globalMin_of_margin {lam r a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hmargin : 0 ≤ lam * a ^ 2 + r) : GlobalMin lam r a
records.proof:
by
  intro x y
  have hb : 0 ≤ lam / 4 * (x + a) ^ 2 + (lam * a ^ 2 + r) / 2 := by
    positivity
  have hp := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (x - a)) hb
  have ht : 0 ≤ (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
  linarith [energy_gap lam r a x y]
records.comment: A nonnegative certificate gives an actual global minimum.

records.statement:
theorem margin_of_globalMin {lam r a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hmin : GlobalMin lam r a) : 0 ≤ lam * a ^ 2 + r
records.proof:
by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst a
    simp only [zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), mul_zero, zero_add]
    by_contra hn
    have hr : r < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hn
    let t : ℝ := Real.sqrt (-r / lam)
    have hq : 0 < -r / lam := div_pos (neg_pos.mpr hr) hlam
    have ht : 0 < t := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hq
    have ht2 : t ^ 2 = -r / lam := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hq)
    have hlt : lam * t ^ 2 = -r := by
      rw [ht2]
      field_simp
    have hg := energy_gap lam r 0 t (Real.sqrt 2 * t)
    have hm := hmin t (Real.sqrt 2 * t)
    simp only [mul_zero] at hm
    have hneg : t ^ 2 * r < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sq_pos_of_pos ht) hr
    simp only [sub_self, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_div, zero_add,
      sub_zero, add_zero, mul_zero] at hg
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => q * t ^ 2) hlt]
  · have hm := hmin (-a) (Real.sqrt 2 * (-a))
    have hg := energy_gap lam r a (-a) (Real.sqrt 2 * (-a))
    have ha2 : 0 < a ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero ha
    by_contra hn
    have hmarg : lam * a ^ 2 + r < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hnprod : a ^ 2 * (lam * a ^ 2 + r) < 0 :=
      mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ha2 hmarg
    simp only [sub_self, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_div, zero_add,
      neg_add_cancel, mul_zero] at hg
    nlinarith
records.comment: Necessity includes the degenerate target a = 0, via a concrete square-root witness.

records.statement:
theorem globalMin_iff_margin {lam r a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    GlobalMin lam r a ↔ 0 ≤ lam * a ^ 2 + r
records.proof: ⟨margin_of_globalMin hlam, globalMin_of_margin (le_of_lt hlam)⟩

records.statement:
theorem quadratic_gap_bound {lam r a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (x y : ℝ) :
    (lam * a ^ 2 + r) / 2 * (x - a) ^ 2 ≤
      E lam r (input lam r a) x y - E lam r (input lam r a) a (Real.sqrt 2 * a)
records.proof:
by
  have hp : 0 ≤ (x - a) ^ 2 * (lam / 4 * (x + a) ^ 2) := by positivity
  have ht : 0 ≤ (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
  linarith [energy_gap lam r a x y]
records.comment: The certificate also controls the squared location error.

records.statement:
theorem unique_of_margin_pos {lam r a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hmargin : 0 < lam * a ^ 2 + r) {x y : ℝ}
    (he : E lam r (input lam r a) x y =
      E lam r (input lam r a) a (Real.sqrt 2 * a)) :
    x = a ∧ y = Real.sqrt 2 * a
records.proof:
by
  have hb := quadratic_gap_bound (r := r) (a := a) hlam x y
  have hsq : (x - a) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have hnonneg := sq_nonneg (x - a)
    nlinarith
  have hx : x = a := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - a)]
  subst x
  have hg := energy_gap lam r a a y
  have hy : (y - Real.sqrt 2 * a) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    simp only [sub_self, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_mul, add_zero] at hg
    linarith
  exact ⟨rfl, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - Real.sqrt 2 * a)]⟩
records.comment: Positive margin forces every point with the same energy to be the target.

records.statement:
theorem equal_energy_iff_of_margin_zero {lam r a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hmargin : lam * a ^ 2 + r = 0) (x y : ℝ) :
    E lam r (input lam r a) x y =
      E lam r (input lam r a) a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) ↔
      (x = a ∨ x = -a) ∧ y = Real.sqrt 2 * x
records.proof:
by
  have hg := energy_gap lam r a x y
  rw [hmargin, zero_div, add_zero] at hg
  have hfirst : 0 ≤ (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
  have hsecond : 0 ≤ (x - a) ^ 2 * (lam / 4 * (x + a) ^ 2) := by positivity
  constructor
  · intro he
    have hs : (x - a) ^ 2 * (lam / 4 * (x + a) ^ 2) = 0 := by linarith
    have hy0 : (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hy : y = Real.sqrt 2 * x := by nlinarith
    refine ⟨?_, hy⟩
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hs with hleft | hright
    · left
      nlinarith
    · have hl : lam / 4 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
      have hx : (x + a) ^ 2 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hright).resolve_left hl
      right
      nlinarith
  · rintro ⟨hx | hx, hy⟩
    · subst x
      subst y
      rfl
    · subst x
      subst y
      simp only [sub_self, neg_add_cancel, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
        zero_div, mul_zero, zero_add] at hg
      linarith
records.comment:
At zero margin the complete equality set is the two reflected targets.
When a = 0 the two descriptions coincide, so this also covers the quartic minimum.

records.statement:
theorem squared_position_error {lam r a x y eps : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hmargin : 0 < lam * a ^ 2 + r)
    (herror : E lam r (input lam r a) x y -
      E lam r (input lam r a) a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) ≤ eps) :
    (x - a) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * eps / (lam * a ^ 2 + r)
records.proof:
by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hmargin).2
  have hb := quadratic_gap_bound (r := r) (a := a) hlam x y
  nlinarith
records.comment: A measured energy error supplies a certified squared position-error bound.

records.statement:
theorem position_error {lam r a x y eps : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hmargin : 0 < lam * a ^ 2 + r)
    (herror : E lam r (input lam r a) x y -
      E lam r (input lam r a) a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) ≤ eps) :
    |x - a| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * eps / (lam * a ^ 2 + r))
records.proof:
by
  exact Real.abs_le_sqrt (squared_position_error hlam hmargin herror)
records.comment: The square-root error estimate displayed by the companion is certified too.

records.statement:
theorem input_shift {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (u v : ℝ) (z : S) :
    energy A X v z = energy A X u z - (v - u) * X z
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  ring

records.statement:
theorem recover_coordinate {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (u v : ℝ)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (z : S) :
    (energy A X u z - energy A X v z) / (v - u) = X z
records.proof:
by
  apply (div_eq_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm huv))).2
  unfold energy
  ring

records.statement:
theorem recover_zero_input_energy {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (u v : ℝ)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (z : S) :
    (v * energy A X u z - u * energy A X v z) / (v - u) = A z
records.proof:
by
  apply (div_eq_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm huv))).2
  unfold energy
  ring

records.statement:
theorem pair_suffices {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (z w : S)
    (hA : A z = A w) (hX : X z = X w) (u : ℝ) :
    energy A X u z = energy A X u w
records.proof:
by
  simp only [energy, hA, hX]

records.statement:
theorem all_inputs_iff_pair {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (z w : S) :
    (∀ u : ℝ, energy A X u z = energy A X u w) ↔
      A z = A w ∧ X z = X w
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hA : A z = A w := by simpa [energy] using h 0
    have h1 := h 1
    simp only [energy, one_mul] at h1
    exact ⟨hA, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨hA, hX⟩ u
    exact pair_suffices A X z w hA hX u

records.statement:
theorem two_inputs_iff_pair {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (z w : S)
    (u v : ℝ) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    (energy A X u z = energy A X u w ∧
      energy A X v z = energy A X v w) ↔
      A z = A w ∧ X z = X w
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hu, hv⟩
    have hX : X z = X w := by
      rw [← recover_coordinate A X u v huv z,
        ← recover_coordinate A X u v huv w, hu, hv]
    have hA : A z = A w := by
      rw [← recover_zero_input_energy A X u v huv z,
        ← recover_zero_input_energy A X u v huv w, hu, hv]
    exact ⟨hA, hX⟩
  · rintro ⟨hA, hX⟩
    exact ⟨pair_suffices A X z w hA hX u,
      pair_suffices A X z w hA hX v⟩

/- Any summary that permits every energy observation also permits the pair.
This is a factorization statement, not a claim about dimension or bit count. -/

records.statement:
theorem summary_decodes_pair {S T : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (summary : S → T)
    (decode : ℝ → T → ℝ)
    (hdecode : ∀ u z, decode u (summary z) = energy A X u z) :
    ∃ pairDecode : T → ℝ × ℝ,
      ∀ z, pairDecode (summary z) = (A z, X z)
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun t => (decode 0 t, decode 0 t - decode 1 t), ?_⟩
  intro z
  simp [hdecode, energy]

records.statement:
theorem pair_decodes_all {S T : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (summary : S → T)
    (pairDecode : T → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hdecode : ∀ z, pairDecode (summary z) = (A z, X z)) :
    ∃ decode : ℝ → T → ℝ,
      ∀ u z, decode u (summary z) = energy A X u z
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun u t => (pairDecode t).1 - u * (pairDecode t).2, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  simp only [hdecode, energy]

records.statement:
theorem recovery_error_identity {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (u v : ℝ)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (z : S) (errorU errorV : ℝ) :
    ((energy A X u z + errorU) - (energy A X v z + errorV)) / (v - u)
      - X z = (errorU - errorV) / (v - u)
records.proof:
by
  have hden : v - u ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm huv)
  unfold energy
  field_simp
  ring

records.statement:
theorem recovery_error_bound {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ) (u v : ℝ)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (z : S) (errorU errorV epsU epsV : ℝ)
    (hU : |errorU| ≤ epsU) (hV : |errorV| ≤ epsV) :
    |((energy A X u z + errorU) - (energy A X v z + errorV)) / (v - u)
      - X z| ≤ (epsU + epsV) / |v - u|
records.proof:
by
  rw [recovery_error_identity A X u v huv z errorU errorV, abs_div]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg (v - u))
  exact (abs_sub errorU errorV).trans (add_le_add hU hV)

records.statement:
theorem minimizer_monotone (V : ℝ → ℝ) (u v xu xv : ℝ) (huv : u < v)
    (hu : ∀ x, V xu - u * xu ≤ V x - u * x)
    (hv : ∀ x, V xv - v * xv ≤ V x - v * x) :
    xu ≤ xv
records.proof:
by
  have h1 := hu xv
  have h2 := hv xu
  have hprod : 0 ≤ (v - u) * (xv - xu) := by nlinarith
  by_contra h
  have hneg : xv - xu < 0 := sub_neg.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have : (v - u) * (xv - xu) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.mpr huv) hneg
  linarith

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_potential (lam r u x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (potential lam r u) (lam * x ^ 3 + r * x - u) x
records.proof:
by
  convert ((((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 4).const_mul lam).div_const 4).add
    ((((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2).const_mul r).div_const 2) |>.sub
    ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul u) using 1
  · rfl
  · simp only [id_eq]
    ring

records.statement:
theorem deriv_potential (lam r u x : ℝ) :
    deriv (potential lam r u) x = lam * x ^ 3 + r * x - u
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_potential lam r u x).deriv

records.statement:
theorem stationary_iff_input (lam r u x : ℝ) :
    deriv (potential lam r u) x = 0 ↔ u = lam * x ^ 3 + r * x
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_potential]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

by
  have hm : IsMinOn (potential lam r u) Set.univ a := fun t _ => hmin t
  have hz := (hm.isLocalMin Filter.univ_mem).hasDerivAt_eq_zero
    (hasDerivAt_potential lam r u a)
  linarith

records.statement:
theorem critical_value {lam r u x : ℝ} (hu : u = lam * x ^ 3 + r * x) :
    potential lam r u x = -3 * lam * x ^ 4 / 4 - r * x ^ 2 / 2
records.proof:
by
  rw [hu]
  unfold potential
  ring

records.statement:
theorem critical_value_le {lam r u x : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hu : u = lam * x ^ 3 + r * x) :
    potential lam r u x ≤ (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)
records.proof:
by
  rw [critical_value hu]
  by_cases hr : 0 ≤ r
  · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith : -r ≤ 0)]
    have h4 : 0 ≤ lam * x ^ 4 := by positivity
    have h2 : 0 ≤ r * x ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hr (sq_nonneg x)
    norm_num
    nlinarith
  · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith : 0 ≤ -r)]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 12 * lam)).2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (3 * lam * x ^ 2 + r)]

records.statement:
theorem critical_value_below_target {lam r u x target : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hu : u = lam * x ^ 3 + r * x)
    (ht : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target) :
    potential lam r u x < target
records.proof: lt_of_le_of_lt (critical_value_le hlam hu) ht

records.statement:
theorem positive_target_counterexample :
    deriv (potential 1 (-1) (10 / 27)) (-2 / 3) = 0 ∧
    potential 1 (-1) (10 / 27) (-2 / 3) = 2 / 27 ∧
    (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 27 ∧ (1 / 27 : ℝ) < 2 / 27
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_potential]
  norm_num [potential]

by
  apply LinearInputCalculus.global_minimum_forces_input
    (lam := lam) (r := r) (a := a)
  intro t
  have ht := hmin t (Real.sqrt 2 * t)
  simpa [E, f, LinearInputCalculus.potential] using ht
records.comment:
An arbitrary input making the target a global minimum must be the design input.
This uses the actual derivative and Fermat's theorem, not a stationarity hypothesis.

records.statement:
theorem global_minimum_iff_input_and_margin {lam r u a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    (∀ x y : ℝ, E lam r u a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) ≤ E lam r u x y) ↔
      u = input lam r a ∧ 0 ≤ lam * a ^ 2 + r
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hu := global_minimum_forces_design h
    refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
    rw [hu] at h
    exact margin_of_globalMin hlam h
  · rintro ⟨hu, hm⟩
    rw [hu]
    exact globalMin_of_margin (le_of_lt hlam) hm
records.comment: Full characterization for an arbitrary input, not only a preselected input.

records.statement:
theorem exists_input_global_minimum_iff {lam r a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    (∃ u : ℝ, ∀ x y : ℝ,
      E lam r u a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) ≤ E lam r u x y) ↔
      0 ≤ lam * a ^ 2 + r
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    exact ((global_minimum_iff_input_and_margin hlam).mp hu).2
  · intro hm
    exact ⟨input lam r a, globalMin_of_margin (le_of_lt hlam) hm⟩
records.comment: Realizability of a prescribed location by some linear input is exactly the margin test.

records.statement:
theorem continuous_energy (lam r u : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => E lam r u z.1 z.2)
records.proof:
by
  unfold E f
  fun_prop

records.statement:
theorem coercive_identity {lam : ℝ} (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (r u x y : ℝ) :
    E lam r u x y + lowerBoundConstant lam r u -
      (x ^ 2 + (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2) =
    (lam * x ^ 2 + r - 3) ^ 2 / (4 * lam) + (x - u) ^ 2 / 2
records.proof:
by
  unfold E f lowerBoundConstant
  field_simp
  ring
records.comment: An explicit sum-of-squares certificate, valid at every state.

records.statement:
theorem coercive_lower_bound {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (r u x y : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 + (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2 ≤
      E lam r u x y + lowerBoundConstant lam r u
records.proof:
by
  have hs : 0 ≤ (lam * x ^ 2 + r - 3) ^ 2 / (4 * lam) + (x - u) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    positivity
  linarith [coercive_identity (ne_of_gt hlam) r u x y]

records.statement:
theorem isCompact_sublevel {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (r u c : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {z : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ c}
records.proof:
by
  let R : ℝ := |c + lowerBoundConstant lam r u| + 1
  have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  have hm : c + lowerBoundConstant lam r u ≤ R - 1 := by
    dsimp [R]
    simpa using le_abs_self (c + lowerBoundConstant lam r u)
  have hs : IsClosed {z : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ c} :=
    isClosed_le (continuous_energy lam r u) continuous_const
  apply (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).of_isClosed_subset hs
  intro z hz
  change z.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R ∧ z.2 ∈ Set.Icc (-(4 * R)) (4 * R)
  have hc := coercive_lower_bound hlam r u z.1 z.2
  have hx2 : z.1 ^ 2 ≤ R - 1 := by
    have hsq := sq_nonneg (z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1)
    dsimp at hz
    linarith
  have ht2 : (z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (R - 1) := by
    have hsq := sq_nonneg z.1
    dsimp at hz
    linarith
  have hx : |z.1| ≤ R := by
    have habs := sq_abs z.1
    have hsq := sq_nonneg (R - 1)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|z.1| - R)]
  have ht : |z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1| ≤ 2 * R := by
    have habs := sq_abs (z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1)
    have hsq := sq_nonneg (R - 1)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1| - 2 * R)]
  have hsqrt : |Real.sqrt 2| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hy : |z.2| ≤ 4 * R := by
    calc
      |z.2| = |(z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1) + Real.sqrt 2 * z.1| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1| + |Real.sqrt 2 * z.1| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1| + |Real.sqrt 2| * |z.1| := by rw [abs_mul]
      _ ≤ 2 * R + 2 * R := add_le_add ht (mul_le_mul hsqrt hx (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
      _ = 4 * R := by ring
  exact ⟨abs_le.mp hx, abs_le.mp hy⟩
records.comment: Compactness includes empty sublevels and uses no lower restriction on c.

records.statement:
theorem isCompact_band {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (r u lo hi : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {z : ℝ × ℝ | lo ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ hi}
records.proof:
by
  have hs : IsClosed {z : ℝ × ℝ | lo ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ hi} :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_energy lam r u)).inter
      (isClosed_le (continuous_energy lam r u) continuous_const)
  exact (isCompact_sublevel hlam r u hi).of_isClosed_subset hs (fun _ hz => hz.2)

records.statement:
theorem exists_global_minimum {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (r u : ℝ) :
    ∃ z : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ E lam r u w.1 w.2
records.proof:
by
  let S : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ E lam r u 0 0}
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨(0, 0), by change E lam r u 0 0 ≤ E lam r u 0 0; exact le_refl _⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hmin⟩ := (isCompact_sublevel hlam r u (E lam r u 0 0)).exists_isMinOn
    hne (continuous_energy lam r u).continuousOn
  refine ⟨z, fun w => ?_⟩
  by_cases hw : w ∈ S
  · exact hmin hw
  · exact le_trans hz (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hw))

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_E_x (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => E lam r u t y) (gx lam r u x y) x
records.proof:
by
  have hf : HasDerivAt (f lam r u) (lam * x ^ 3 + r * x - u) x :=
    LinearInputCalculus.hasDerivAt_potential lam r u x
  convert hf.add (((hasDerivAt_const x y).sub
    ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (Real.sqrt 2))).pow 2 |>.div_const 2) using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp [gx]
    ring_nf
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    ring

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_E_y (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => E lam r u x t) (gy x y) y
records.proof:
by
  convert (hasDerivAt_const y (f lam r u x)).add
    (((hasDerivAt_id y).sub_const (Real.sqrt 2 * x)).pow 2 |>.div_const 2) using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp [gy]
    ring

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_E_input (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => E lam r t x y) (-x) u
records.proof:
by
  convert ((hasDerivAt_const u (lam * x ^ 4 / 4 + r * x ^ 2 / 2)).sub
    ((hasDerivAt_id u).mul_const x)).add_const
    ((y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2) using 1
  · rfl
  · simp

records.statement:
theorem deriv_E_x (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => E lam r u t y) x = gx lam r u x y
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_E_x lam r u x y).deriv

records.statement:
theorem deriv_E_y (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => E lam r u x t) y = gy x y
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_E_y lam r u x y).deriv

records.statement:
theorem stationary_iff (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    gx lam r u x y = 0 ∧ gy x y = 0 ↔
      y = Real.sqrt 2 * x ∧ u = lam * x ^ 3 + r * x
records.proof:
by
  have hs : (Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  dsimp [gx, gy]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    have hy' : y = Real.sqrt 2 * x := by linarith
    refine ⟨hy', ?_⟩
    rw [hy'] at hx
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun s : ℝ => s * x) hs]
  · rintro ⟨hy, hu⟩
    rw [hy, hu]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [congrArg (fun s : ℝ => s * x) hs]
    · ring

records.statement:
theorem partials_zero_iff (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    (deriv (fun t : ℝ => E lam r u t y) x = 0 ∧
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => E lam r u x t) y = 0) ↔
      y = Real.sqrt 2 * x ∧ u = lam * x ^ 3 + r * x
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_E_x, deriv_E_y, stationary_iff]

records.statement:
theorem stationary_value_le {lam r u x y : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hg : gx lam r u x y = 0 ∧ gy x y = 0) :
    E lam r u x y ≤ (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨hy, hu⟩ := (stationary_iff lam r u x y).1 hg
  rw [hy]
  simpa only [E, f, LinearInputCalculus.potential, sub_self, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_div, add_zero]
    using LinearInputCalculus.critical_value_le hlam hu

records.statement:
theorem no_stationary_on_band {lam r u x y target : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (ht : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (he : target ≤ E lam r u x y) :
    ¬ (gx lam r u x y = 0 ∧ gy x y = 0)
records.proof:
by
  intro hg
  linarith [stationary_value_le hlam hg]

records.statement: theorem gSq_nonneg (lam r u x y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ gSq lam r u x y
records.proof:
by
  unfold gSq
  positivity

records.statement:
theorem gSq_eq_zero_iff (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    gSq lam r u x y = 0 ↔ gx lam r u x y = 0 ∧ gy x y = 0
records.proof:
by
  unfold gSq
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gx lam r u x y), sq_nonneg (gy x y)]
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    rw [hx, hy]
    norm_num

records.statement:
theorem gSq_pos_on_band {lam r u x y target : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (ht : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (he : target ≤ E lam r u x y) :
    0 < gSq lam r u x y
records.proof:
by
  have hn := gSq_nonneg lam r u x y
  have hne : gSq lam r u x y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact no_stationary_on_band hlam ht he ((gSq_eq_zero_iff lam r u x y).1 hz)
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hn (Ne.symm hne)

records.statement:
theorem continuous_E (lam r u : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => E lam r u z.1 z.2)
records.proof:
by
  exact (((continuous_const.mul (continuous_fst.pow 4)).div_const 4).add
    ((continuous_const.mul (continuous_fst.pow 2)).div_const 2) |>.sub
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst)).add
    ((continuous_snd.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst)).pow 2 |>.div_const 2)

records.statement:
theorem continuous_gSq (lam r u : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => gSq lam r u z.1 z.2)
records.proof:
by
  exact ((((continuous_const.mul (continuous_fst.pow 3)).add
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst)).sub
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd) |>.sub continuous_const).pow 2).add
    ((continuous_snd.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst)).pow 2)

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_curve {x y u : ℝ → ℝ} {t x' y' u' : ℝ}
    (lam r : ℝ) (hx : HasDerivAt x x' t) (hy : HasDerivAt y y' t)
    (hu : HasDerivAt u u' t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r (u s) (x s) (y s))
      (gx lam r (u t) (x t) (y t) * x' + gy (x t) (y t) * y' - x t * u') t
records.proof:
by
  convert (((((hx.pow 4).const_mul lam).div_const 4).add
    (((hx.pow 2).const_mul r).div_const 2)).sub (hu.mul hx)).add
    (((hy.sub (hx.const_mul (Real.sqrt 2))).pow 2).div_const 2) using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp [gx, gy]
    ring_nf
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    ring
records.comment: The input is allowed to move: its work term is forced by the actual chain rule.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_of_velocity {x y u : ℝ → ℝ} {t u' : ℝ}
    (lam r gamma target b : ℝ)
    (hx : HasDerivAt x
      (-gamma * (E lam r (u t) (x t) (y t) - target) * gx lam r (u t) (x t) (y t)
        - b * gy (x t) (y t)) t)
    (hy : HasDerivAt y
      (-gamma * (E lam r (u t) (x t) (y t) - target) * gy (x t) (y t)
        + b * gx lam r (u t) (x t) (y t)) t)
    (hu : HasDerivAt u u' t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r (u s) (x s) (y s))
      (-gamma * (E lam r (u t) (x t) (y t) - target) *
        gSq lam r (u t) (x t) (y t) - x t * u') t
records.proof:
by
  convert hasDerivAt_energy_curve lam r hx hy hu using 1
  unfold gSq
  ring
records.comment:
Conditional on actual coordinate velocities, the tangential part cancels.
The moving input contributes the term `-x t * u'`; no existence assertion is made.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_fixed_input {x y : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (lam r u gamma target b : ℝ)
    (hx : HasDerivAt x
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)
        - b * gy (x t) (y t)) t)
    (hy : HasDerivAt y
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) * gy (x t) (y t)
        + b * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s))
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
        gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) t
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [mul_zero, sub_zero] using
    hasDerivAt_energy_of_velocity (u := fun _ => u) lam r gamma target b hx hy
      (hasDerivAt_const t u)
records.comment: With fixed input, this is the genuine energy derivative along any such curve.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_squared_gap_fixed_input {x y : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (lam r u gamma target b : ℝ)
    (hx : HasDerivAt x
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)
        - b * gy (x t) (y t)) t)
    (hy : HasDerivAt y
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) * gy (x t) (y t)
        + b * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (E lam r u (x s) (y s) - target) ^ 2)
      (-2 * gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) ^ 2 *
        gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) t
records.proof:
by
  convert ((hasDerivAt_energy_fixed_input lam r u gamma target b hx hy).sub_const
    target).pow 2 using 1
  ring
records.comment: The squared energy gap has the expected derivative, derived by the chain rule.

records.statement:
theorem exponential_bound {v q : ℝ → ℝ} {k : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt v (q t) t)
    (hi : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), q t ≤ -k * v t)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    v t ≤ v 0 * Real.exp (-k * t)
records.proof:
by
  let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (k * s) * v s
  let dw : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (k * s) * (k * v s + q s)
  have hw : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt w (dw s) s := by
    intro s hs
    convert (((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul k).exp.mul (hd s hs)) using 1
    · rfl
    · dsimp [dw]
      ring
  have hc : ContinuousOn w (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) := fun s hs =>
    (hw s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have ha : AntitoneOn w (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) :=
    antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ)) hc
      (fun s hs => (hw s (interior_subset hs)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun s hs => by
        dsimp [dw]
        apply mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
        have h := hi s (interior_subset hs)
        linarith)
  have hvalue : Real.exp (k * t) * v t ≤ v 0 := by
    simpa [w] using ha (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici 0 by simp) ht ht
  have hdiv : v t ≤ v 0 / Real.exp (k * t) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).2
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hvalue
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg, neg_mul] using hdiv
records.comment: Integrating-factor estimate; no sign assumption on v or the rate is needed.

records.statement:
theorem squared_error_exponential {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma m : ℝ}
    (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e t * g t) t)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), m ≤ g t)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (e t) ^ 2 ≤ (e 0) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * gamma * m) * t)
records.proof:
by
  apply exponential_bound
    (v := fun s => (e s) ^ 2) (k := 2 * gamma * m) (t := t)
    (q := fun s => -2 * gamma * (e s) ^ 2 * g s)
  · intro s hs
    convert (hd s hs).pow 2 using 1
    ring
  · intro s hs
    have hp : 0 ≤ gamma * (e s) ^ 2 * (g s - m) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hgamma (sq_nonneg _)) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hg s hs))
    nlinarith
  · exact ht
records.comment:
A nonnegative damping coefficient gives a square-energy exponential bound
whenever a supplied solution has a common positive (or zero) damping bound.

records.statement:
theorem squared_error_tendsto_zero {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma m : ℝ}
    (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e t * g t) t)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), m ≤ g t) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (e t) ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
records.proof:
by
  have hc : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (2 * gamma * m) * t)
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Filter.tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop (by positivity)
  have hb : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun t : ℝ => (e 0) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * gamma * m) * t))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, neg_mul, mul_zero] using
      (Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.comp hc).const_mul ((e 0) ^ 2)
  apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => sq_nonneg (e t))) _ hb
  exact (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)).mono
    (fun t ht => squared_error_exponential (le_of_lt hgamma) hd hg ht)
records.comment: Squared error tends to zero for a supplied trajectory with positive rate.

records.statement:
theorem error_tendsto_zero {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma m : ℝ}
    (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e t * g t) t)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), m ≤ g t) :
    Filter.Tendsto e Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
records.proof:
by
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_abs_tendsto_zero]
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, Real.sqrt_zero, Function.comp_def] using
    (squared_error_tendsto_zero hgamma hm hd hg).sqrt

records.statement:
theorem band_nonempty {lam r u lo hi : ℝ} (hlo : 0 ≤ lo) (horder : lo ≤ hi) :
    {z : ℝ × ℝ | lo ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ hi}.Nonempty
records.proof:
by
  have he : E lam r u 0 (Real.sqrt (2 * lo)) = lo := by
    simp only [E, f, zero_pow (by decide : 4 ≠ 0), zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
      mul_zero, zero_div, zero_add, sub_zero]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hlo)]
    ring
  refine ⟨(0, Real.sqrt (2 * lo)), ?_⟩
  change lo ≤ E lam r u 0 (Real.sqrt (2 * lo)) ∧ E lam r u 0 (Real.sqrt (2 * lo)) ≤ hi
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨le_refl lo, horder⟩

records.statement:
theorem exists_positive_gradient_bound {lam r u lo hi : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hlo : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < lo) :
    ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ,
      (lo ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ hi) →
      m ≤ gSq lam r u z.1 z.2
records.proof:
by
  exact (LinearInputCoercivity.isCompact_band hlam r u lo hi).exists_forall_le'
    (continuous_gSq lam r u).continuousOn
    (fun z hz => gSq_pos_on_band hlam hlo hz.1)
records.comment: The positive lower bound depends on the fixed input and the fixed band.

records.statement:
theorem exists_valley_global_minimum {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (r u : ℝ) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, ∀ x y : ℝ, E lam r u a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) ≤ E lam r u x y
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := LinearInputCoercivity.exists_global_minimum hlam r u
  have hc := hz (z.1, Real.sqrt 2 * z.1)
  have hy : z.2 = Real.sqrt 2 * z.1 := by
    simp only [E, sub_self, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_div, add_zero] at hc
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1)]
  refine ⟨z.1, fun x y => ?_⟩
  simpa only [hy] using hz (x, y)
records.comment: For every fixed input the global minimum exists on the valley y = sqrt(2) x.

records.statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_stationary_root {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (r u : ℝ) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, u = input lam r a ∧ 0 ≤ lam * a ^ 2 + r ∧
      ∀ x y : ℝ, E lam r u a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) ≤ E lam r u x y
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_valley_global_minimum hlam r u
  obtain ⟨hu, hm⟩ := (LinearInputConsequences.global_minimum_iff_input_and_margin hlam).mp ha
  exact ⟨a, hu, hm, ha⟩

by
  obtain ⟨a, hui, hm, ha⟩ := exists_minimizing_stationary_root hlam r u
  have hp : 0 < lam * a ^ 2 + r := by
    by_contra hn
    have hz : lam * a ^ 2 + r = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) hm
    apply hu
    rw [hui]
    unfold input
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun s : ℝ => s * a) hz]
  refine ⟨(a, Real.sqrt 2 * a), fun w => ha w.1 w.2, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have he : E lam r (input lam r a) z.1 z.2 =
      E lam r (input lam r a) a (Real.sqrt 2 * a) := by
    rw [← hui]
    exact le_antisymm (hz (a, Real.sqrt 2 * a)) (ha z.1 z.2)
  obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := unique_of_margin_pos (le_of_lt hlam) hp he
  exact Prod.ext hx hy
records.comment: Every nonzero fixed input has a unique full-plane global minimizer.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_gap_of_trajectory {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s) - target)
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) * gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) t
records.proof:
(hasDerivAt_energy_fixed_input lam r u gamma target (b t)
    (htraj t ht).1 (htraj t ht).2).sub_const target

records.statement:
theorem energy_convergence_in_band {lam r u gamma target upper : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {x y b : ℝ → ℝ} (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hband : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      target ≤ E lam r u (x t) (y t) ∧ E lam r u (x t) (y t) ≤ upper) :
    ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) ^ 2 ≤
          (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0) - target) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * gamma * m) * t)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun t => E lam r u (x t) (y t)) Filter.atTop (nhds target)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hbound⟩ := exists_positive_gradient_bound
    (r := r) (u := u) (hi := upper) hlam htarget
  have hge : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), m ≤ gSq lam r u (x t) (y t) :=
    fun t ht => hbound (x t, y t) (hband t ht)
  have hde : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s) - target)
        (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) * gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) t :=
    fun _ ht => hasDerivAt_gap_of_trajectory htraj ht
  refine ⟨m, hm, fun t ht => ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact LinearInputDissipation.squared_error_exponential (le_of_lt hgamma) hde hge ht
  · have he := LinearInputDissipation.error_tendsto_zero hgamma hm hde hge
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using he.add_const target
records.comment:
Energy convergence along a supplied globally defined trajectory in the band.
The band assumption and the coordinate ODE are explicit premises.

records.statement:
theorem squared_error_antitone {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma : ℝ}
    (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e t * g t) t)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ g t) :
    AntitoneOn (fun t => (e t) ^ 2) (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ))
records.proof:
by
  have hsq : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (e s) ^ 2) (-2 * gamma * (e t) ^ 2 * g t) t := by
    intro t ht
    convert (hd t ht).pow 2 using 1
    ring
  exact antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ))
    (fun t ht => (hsq t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun t ht => (hsq t (interior_subset ht)).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (fun t ht => by
      have hn : 0 ≤ 2 * gamma * (e t) ^ 2 * g t := by
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hgamma)
          (sq_nonneg _)) (hg t (interior_subset ht))
      nlinarith)
records.comment: Nonnegative damping makes the squared error antitone on nonnegative time.

records.statement:
theorem error_nonneg {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma : ℝ}
    (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e t * g t) t)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ g t)
    (he0 : 0 ≤ e 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 ≤ e t
records.proof:
by
  by_contra hn
  have hneg : e t < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hn
  have hc : ContinuousOn e (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t) :=
    fun s hs => (hd s hs.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hz⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' ht hc
    (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (e t) (e 0) from ⟨le_of_lt hneg, he0⟩)
  have hbound := squared_error_antitone hgamma hd hg hs.1 ht hs.2
  dsimp only at hbound
  rw [hz] at hbound
  nlinarith [sq_pos_of_neg hneg]
records.comment: A zero crossing cannot be followed by a negative error: its square would grow.

records.statement:
theorem error_le_initial {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma : ℝ}
    (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e t * g t) t)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ g t)
    (he0 : 0 ≤ e 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : e t ≤ e 0
records.proof:
by
  have he := error_nonneg hgamma hd hg he0 ht
  have hs := squared_error_antitone hgamma hd hg
    (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici 0 by simp) ht ht
  nlinarith

records.statement:
theorem energy_band_of_trajectory {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma) (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      target ≤ E lam r u (x t) (y t) ∧
        E lam r u (x t) (y t) ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)
records.proof:
by
  have hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s) - target)
        (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
          gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) t :=
    fun _ ht => hasDerivAt_gap_of_trajectory htraj ht
  have hg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ gSq lam r u (x t) (y t) :=
    fun t _ => gSq_nonneg lam r u (x t) (y t)
  intro t ht
  have hlo := error_nonneg hgamma hd hg (sub_nonneg.mpr hinit) ht
  have hhi := error_le_initial hgamma hd hg (sub_nonneg.mpr hinit) ht
  constructor <;> linarith
records.comment: The original energy band follows from the actual ODE and the initial energy.

records.statement:
theorem energy_convergence_of_initial {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {x y b : ℝ → ℝ} (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) :
    ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) ^ 2 ≤
          (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0) - target) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * gamma * m) * t)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun t => E lam r u (x t) (y t)) Filter.atTop (nhds target)
records.proof:
by
  exact energy_convergence_in_band hlam hgamma htarget htraj
    (energy_band_of_trajectory (le_of_lt hgamma) htraj hinit)
records.comment:
Exponential energy convergence now needs an initial condition, not assumed confinement.
The coordinate trajectory is still supplied, so global existence remains separate.

records.statement:
theorem energy_shear (k sigma u x p : ℝ) :
    E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u x (p + Real.sqrt 2 * x) =
      p ^ 2 / 2 + x ^ 4 / 8 - sigma * x ^ 2 / (2 * k) - u * x
records.proof:
by
  unfold E f
  ring
records.comment: The shear identifies the explicit energy with the classical quartic first integral.

records.statement: theorem gy_shear (x p : ℝ) : gy x (p + Real.sqrt 2 * x) = p
records.proof:
by
  unfold gy
  ring

records.statement:
theorem gx_shear (k sigma u x p : ℝ) :
    gx (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u x (p + Real.sqrt 2 * x) =
      x ^ 3 / 2 - sigma / k * x - Real.sqrt 2 * p - u
records.proof:
by
  unfold gx
  ring_nf
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  ring

records.statement:
theorem forced_phase_hasDerivAt {k sigma u s : ℝ} {kappa : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (heq : k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 - sigma * kappa s = k * u) :
    HasDerivAt kappa (gy (kappa s) (deriv kappa s + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa s)) s ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv kappa t + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa t)
      (-gx (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u (kappa s)
        (deriv kappa s + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa s)) s
records.proof:
by
  have hx := (hκ.differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt
  have hp := (hκ.differentiable_deriv_two s).hasDerivAt
  have hacc : deriv (deriv kappa) s = sigma / k * kappa s - (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 + u := by
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hk)
    field_simp
    nlinarith [heq]
  constructor
  · simpa only [gy_shear] using hx
  · convert hp.add (hx.const_mul (Real.sqrt 2)) using 1
    rw [gx_shear, hacc]
    ring
records.comment:
A forced curvature equation gives the actual phase velocities `(gy, -gx)`.
The variable is arclength; no time evolution or solution existence is asserted.

records.statement:
theorem phase_hasDerivAt {k sigma s : ℝ} {kappa : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (heq : k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 - sigma * kappa s = 0) :
    HasDerivAt kappa (gy (kappa s) (deriv kappa s + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa s)) s ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv kappa t + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa t)
      (-gx (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) 0 (kappa s)
        (deriv kappa s + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa s)) s
records.proof:
by
  exact forced_phase_hasDerivAt hk hκ (by simpa only [mul_zero] using heq)
records.comment: The unforced classical elastica curvature equation gives the zero-input phase system.

records.statement:
theorem forced_curvature_of_phase {k sigma u s : ℝ} {kappa : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (hy : HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv kappa t + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa t)
      (-gx (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u (kappa s)
        (deriv kappa s + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa s)) s) :
    k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 - sigma * kappa s = k * u
records.proof:
by
  have hx := (hκ.differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt
  have hp := (hκ.differentiable_deriv_two s).hasDerivAt
  have h := hy.unique (hp.add (hx.const_mul (Real.sqrt 2)))
  rw [gx_shear] at h
  have hmul := congrArg (fun q : ℝ => k * q) h
  field_simp at hmul
  nlinarith [hmul]
records.comment:
Conversely the phase velocities imply the same forced curvature equation.
The derivative here is the actual derivative of the sheared curvature curve.

records.statement:
theorem forced_energy_hasDerivAt_zero {k sigma u s : ℝ} {kappa : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (heq : k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 - sigma * kappa s = k * u) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u (kappa t)
      (deriv kappa t + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa t)) 0 s
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := forced_phase_hasDerivAt hk hκ heq
  convert hasDerivAt_energy_curve (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) hx hy (hasDerivAt_const s u) using 1
  ring
records.comment: The actual derivative of the energy vanishes along a fixed-input phase curve.

records.statement:
theorem energy_hasDerivAt_zero {k sigma s : ℝ} {kappa : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (heq : k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 - sigma * kappa s = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) 0 (kappa t)
      (deriv kappa t + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa t)) 0 s
records.proof:
by
  exact forced_energy_hasDerivAt_zero hk hκ (by simpa only [mul_zero] using heq)

records.statement:
theorem forced_energy_constant {k sigma u a b : ℝ} {kappa : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (heq : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 - sigma * kappa s = k * u) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u (kappa s)
        (deriv kappa s + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa s) = c
records.proof:
by
  apply isOpen_Ioo.exists_is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (convex_Ioo a b).isPreconnected
  · intro s hs
    exact (forced_energy_hasDerivAt_zero hk hκ (heq s hs)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro s hs
    exact (forced_energy_hasDerivAt_zero hk hκ (heq s hs)).deriv
records.comment: A connected open interval turns the actual vanishing derivative into a conserved value.

records.statement:
theorem energy_constant {k sigma a b : ℝ} {kappa : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (heq : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 - sigma * kappa s = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) 0 (kappa s)
        (deriv kappa s + Real.sqrt 2 * kappa s) = c
records.proof:
by
  exact forced_energy_constant hk hκ (fun s hs => by simpa only [mul_zero] using heq s hs)

records.statement:
theorem energy_linear_density {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (u : ℝ) :
    energy (fun q => ε q - u * q) θ ℓ =
      energy ε θ ℓ - u * (θ ℓ - θ 0)
records.proof:
by
  have h := energy_affine_density hε hθ (-u) 0 ℓ
  simpa only [neg_mul, add_neg_cancel, zero_mul, add_zero, sub_eq_add_neg] using h
records.comment:
A curvature-linear density changes the actual energy only by the endpoint
angle difference.  Here the endpoint angles are real-valued lifts.

records.proof:
by
  simpa only [neg_mul, add_zero, sub_eq_add_neg] using
    stationary_affine_density_iff hε hθ (-u) 0
records.comment:
Fixed endpoint-angle variations have the same actual derivative
stationarity after adding a curvature-linear density.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_linear_density_iff {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (u : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing (fun q => ε q - u * q) θ ℓ ↔
      LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [neg_mul, add_zero, sub_eq_add_neg] using
    locallyMinimizing_affine_density_iff hε hθ (-u) 0
records.comment:
The original constrained local-minimum predicate is unchanged by this
linear density, including its original C¹ neighborhood definition.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_quadratic_curvature {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hstat : Stationary (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = 0
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, σ, heq⟩ :=
    stationary_angle_firstIntegral_curvature hℓ (by fun_prop) hθ hstat
  refine ⟨σ, fun s hs => ?_⟩
  exact quadratic_curvature_equation (hθ.deriv' (n := 2)) (heq s hs).2.2
records.comment:
The actual constrained stationarity theorem supplies the classical
curvature equation; it is not assumed as extra input.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_quadratic_phase_energy {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hstat : Stationary (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ) :
    ∃ σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) 0 (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (gy (deriv θ s) (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) 0 (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨σ, heq⟩ := stationary_quadratic_curvature hℓ hθ hstat
  have hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv θ) := hθ.deriv' (n := 2)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := LinearInputCurvatureBridge.energy_constant (ne_of_gt hk) hκ heq
  refine ⟨σ, c, fun s hs => ⟨hc s hs, ?_⟩⟩
  exact LinearInputCurvatureBridge.phase_hasDerivAt (ne_of_gt hk) hκ (heq s hs)
records.comment:
Actual constrained stationarity produces the quartic phase energy and its
Hamiltonian equations along arc length.  The phase input is exactly zero.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_linear_quadratic_phase_energy
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k u : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2 - u * q) θ ℓ) :
    ∃ σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) 0 (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (gy (deriv θ s) (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) 0 (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hmin0 : LocallyMinimizing (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ :=
    (locallyMinimizing_linear_density_iff (by fun_prop) hθ1 u).mp hmin
  have hstat := locallyMinimizing_stationary_of_nonstraight hℓ (by fun_prop) hθ1
    (exists_nonzero_curvature_of_nonconstant hℓ hθ1 hne) hmin0
  exact stationary_quadratic_phase_energy hℓ hk hθ hstat
records.comment:
A nonstraight constrained local minimum of the quadratic density with
any curvature-linear addition yields the same unforced quartic phase system.
Neither stationarity nor the curvature equation is supplied as a hypothesis.
The constant σ is chosen for the quadratic representative of the density.

records.statement:
theorem feedback_rate (px py gamma gap b : ℝ) :
    px * (-gamma * gap * px - b * py) +
      py * (-gamma * gap * py + b * px) =
        -gamma * gap * (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)
records.proof:
by
  ring
records.comment: Every feedback velocity satisfies the chosen energy-rate identity.

records.statement:
theorem feedback_coefficient {px py : ℝ} (hpos : 0 < px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)
    (gamma gap b : ℝ) :
    (px * (-gamma * gap * py + b * px) -
      py * (-gamma * gap * px - b * py)) / (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2) = b
records.proof:
by
  apply (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hpos)).2
  ring
records.comment: At a regular point the coefficient is recovered by the oriented area.

records.statement:
theorem decomposition_of_rate {px py vx vy gamma gap : ℝ}
    (hpos : 0 < px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)
    (hrate : px * vx + py * vy = -gamma * gap * (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) :
    vx = -gamma * gap * px -
        ((px * vy - py * vx) / (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) * py ∧
      vy = -gamma * gap * py +
        ((px * vy - py * vx) / (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) * px
records.proof:
by
  have hn : px ^ 2 + py ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpos
  constructor
  · field_simp
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => q * px) hrate]
  · field_simp
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => q * py) hrate]
records.comment: The scalar rate constraint gives the explicit tangential decomposition.

records.statement:
theorem rate_iff_exists_unique_feedback {px py vx vy gamma gap : ℝ}
    (hpos : 0 < px ^ 2 + py ^ 2) :
    (px * vx + py * vy = -gamma * gap * (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ, vx = -gamma * gap * px - b * py ∧
        vy = -gamma * gap * py + b * px
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hrate
    refine ⟨(px * vy - py * vx) / (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2),
      decomposition_of_rate hpos hrate, ?_⟩
    intro b hb
    rw [hb.1, hb.2]
    exact (feedback_coefficient hpos gamma gap b).symm
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, _⟩
    rw [hb.1, hb.2]
    exact feedback_rate px py gamma gap b
records.comment:
The coefficient is unique for each velocity, although the rate law allows
every coefficient and thus does not select a velocity.

records.statement:
theorem zero_gradient_rate (vx vy gamma gap : ℝ) :
    (0 : ℝ) * vx + 0 * vy = -gamma * gap * (0 ^ 2 + 0 ^ 2)
records.proof:
by
  ring
records.comment:
Without a regularity hypothesis the rate constraint imposes no velocity
restriction at a zero gradient.

records.statement:
theorem zero_gradient_feedback_iff (vx vy gamma gap : ℝ) :
    (∃ b : ℝ, vx = -gamma * gap * 0 - b * 0 ∧
      vy = -gamma * gap * 0 + b * 0) ↔ vx = 0 ∧ vy = 0
records.proof:
by
  simp
records.comment: At a zero gradient the feedback expression only represents zero velocity.

records.statement:
theorem zero_gradient_counterexample (gamma gap : ℝ) :
    (0 : ℝ) * 1 + 0 * 0 = -gamma * gap * (0 ^ 2 + 0 ^ 2) ∧
      ¬ ∃ b : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) = -gamma * gap * 0 - b * 0 ∧
        (0 : ℝ) = -gamma * gap * 0 + b * 0
records.proof:
by
  norm_num
records.comment:
The unit horizontal velocity is an exact obstruction to extending the
decomposition equivalence across zero gradients.

records.statement:
theorem energy_rate_iff_exists_unique_feedback {lam r u x y vx vy gamma target : ℝ}
    (hpos : 0 < gSq lam r u x y) :
    (gx lam r u x y * vx + gy x y * vy =
      -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gSq lam r u x y) ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ,
        vx = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gx lam r u x y - b * gy x y ∧
        vy = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gy x y + b * gx lam r u x y
records.proof:
by
  exact rate_iff_exists_unique_feedback hpos
records.comment:
Instantiation uses the actual polynomial partial derivatives proved in
LinearInputGradient, without assuming a derivative formula.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_iff_exists_unique_feedback
    {x y : ℝ → ℝ} {t vx vy lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    (hx : HasDerivAt x vx t) (hy : HasDerivAt y vy t)
    (hpos : 0 < gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s))
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
        gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) t ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ,
        vx = -gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
          gx lam r u (x t) (y t) - b * gy (x t) (y t) ∧
        vy = -gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
          gy (x t) (y t) + b * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)
records.proof:
by
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s))
      (gx lam r u (x t) (y t) * vx + gy (x t) (y t) * vy) t := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, sub_zero] using
      hasDerivAt_energy_curve lam r hx hy (hasDerivAt_const t u)
  rw [← energy_rate_iff_exists_unique_feedback hpos]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hd.unique h
  · intro h
    rwa [h] at hd
records.comment:
The same equivalence expressed as an actual derivative along a curve,
using the already proved polynomial chain rule and uniqueness of derivatives.

records.statement:
theorem energy_rate_iff_exists_unique_feedback_on_band
    {lam r u x y vx vy gamma target : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (he : target ≤ E lam r u x y) :
    (gx lam r u x y * vx + gy x y * vy =
      -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gSq lam r u x y) ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ,
        vx = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gx lam r u x y - b * gy x y ∧
        vy = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gy x y + b * gx lam r u x y
records.proof:
by
  exact energy_rate_iff_exists_unique_feedback (gSq_pos_on_band hlam htarget he)
records.comment: Above the critical-value bound, regularity follows from the energy band.

records.statement:
theorem exists_three_multipliers_of_kernel
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (f c₁ c₂ c₃ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (h : ∀ v, c₁ v = 0 → c₂ v = 0 → c₃ v = 0 → f v = 0) :
    ∃ lam mu p : ℝ, ∀ v,
      f v + lam * c₁ v + mu * c₂ v + p * c₃ v = 0
records.proof:
by
  let c : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) := c₁.prod (c₂.prod c₃)
  have hf : f ∈ (LinearMap.ker c).dualAnnihilator := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
    intro v hv
    have hv' : c v = 0 := hv
    exact h v (congrArg Prod.fst hv')
      (congrArg (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z.2.1) hv')
      (congrArg (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z.2.2) hv')
  rw [← LinearMap.range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker] at hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨-g (1, (0, 0)), -g (0, (1, 0)), -g (0, (0, 1)), ?_⟩
  intro v
  have hgv : g (c v) = f v := DFunLike.congr_fun hg v
  have hc : c v = (c₁ v) • (1, (0, 0)) +
      (c₂ v) • (0, (1, 0)) + (c₃ v) • (0, (0, 1)) := by
    ext <;> simp [c]
  rw [hc, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul] at hgv
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hgv
  nlinarith

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_parameter_integral
    {G D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G))
    (hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D))
    (hd : ∀ t s, HasDerivAt (fun p => G p s) (D t s) t) (ℓ t₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G t s) (∫ s in 0..ℓ, D t₀ s) t₀
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall t₀ 1).prod (isCompact_uIcc : IsCompact (uIcc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hD.continuousOn
  have hGs (t : ℝ) : Continuous (G t) := hG.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hDs (t : ℝ) : Continuous (D t) := hD.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  apply (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (s := ball t₀ 1) (bound := fun _ => C) (ball_mem_nhds t₀ one_pos)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun t => (hGs t).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((hGs t₀).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) (hDs t₀).aestronglyMeasurable
    ?_ (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) ?_).2
  · filter_upwards [] with s hs
    intro t ht
    exact hC (t, s) ⟨ball_subset_closedBall ht, uIoc_subset_uIcc hs⟩
  · filter_upwards [] with s _ t _
    exact hd t s
records.comment: Compact domination for a genuine continuous parameter derivative.

records.proof:
by
  apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous
    (s := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2) ?_ continuous_snd
  exact hG.comp ((continuous_fst.fst).prodMk continuous_snd)
records.comment: A primitive with jointly continuous parameter and endpoint.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_xCoord_variation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) (t s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun p => xCoord (angleVariation θ η p) 0 s)
      (∫ q in 0..s, -sin (θ q + t * η q) * η q) t
records.proof:
by
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => θ p.2 + p.1 * η p.2) :=
    (hθ.comp continuous_snd).add (continuous_fst.mul (hη.comp continuous_snd))
  have h := hasDerivAt_parameter_integral
    (G := fun p q => cos (θ q + p * η q))
    (D := fun p q => -sin (θ q + p * η q) * η q)
    (Real.continuous_cos.comp hc)
    (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hc).neg).mul (hη.comp continuous_snd))
    (fun p q => by simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id p).mul_const (η q)).const_add (θ q)).cos) s t
  simpa only [xCoord, angleVariation, zero_add] using h
records.comment: Parameter derivative of the actual horizontal reconstructed coordinate.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_yCoord_variation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) (t s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun p => yCoord (angleVariation θ η p) 0 s)
      (∫ q in 0..s, cos (θ q + t * η q) * η q) t
records.proof:
by
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => θ p.2 + p.1 * η p.2) :=
    (hθ.comp continuous_snd).add (continuous_fst.mul (hη.comp continuous_snd))
  have h := hasDerivAt_parameter_integral
    (G := fun p q => sin (θ q + p * η q))
    (D := fun p q => cos (θ q + p * η q) * η q)
    (Real.continuous_sin.comp hc)
    ((Real.continuous_cos.comp hc).mul (hη.comp continuous_snd))
    (fun p q => by simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id p).mul_const (η q)).const_add (θ q)).sin) s t
  simpa only [yCoord, angleVariation, zero_add] using h
records.comment: Parameter derivative of the actual vertical reconstructed coordinate.

records.statement:
theorem continuous_moment {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) :
    Continuous (fun s => xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s))
records.proof:
by
  have hx : Continuous (xCoord θ 0) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ 0 s).continuousAt
  have hy : Continuous (yCoord θ 0) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ 0 s).continuousAt
  exact (hx.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ)).add (hy.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ))
records.comment: Continuity of the area moment entering the first variation.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_area_variation_raw {θ η : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => area (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      ((1 / 2) * ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
        (∫ q in 0..s, -sin (θ q) * η q) * sin (θ s) +
          xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s) -
        ((∫ q in 0..s, cos (θ q) * η q) * cos (θ s) +
          yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s))) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => θ p.2 + p.1 * η p.2) :=
    (hθ.comp continuous_snd).add (continuous_fst.mul (hη.comp continuous_snd))
  have hX : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => xCoord (angleVariation θ η p.1) 0 p.2) := by
    simpa only [xCoord, angleVariation, zero_add] using
      continuous_primitive_parameter (G := fun t s => cos (θ s + t * η s))
        (Real.continuous_cos.comp hc)
  have hY : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => yCoord (angleVariation θ η p.1) 0 p.2) := by
    simpa only [yCoord, angleVariation, zero_add] using
      continuous_primitive_parameter (G := fun t s => sin (θ s + t * η s))
        (Real.continuous_sin.comp hc)
  have hU : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ q in 0..p.2, -sin (θ q + p.1 * η q) * η q) :=
    continuous_primitive_parameter (G := fun t q => -sin (θ q + t * η q) * η q)
      ((Real.continuous_sin.comp hc).neg.mul (hη.comp continuous_snd))
  have hV : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ q in 0..p.2, cos (θ q + p.1 * η q) * η q) :=
    continuous_primitive_parameter (G := fun t q => cos (θ q + t * η q) * η q)
      ((Real.continuous_cos.comp hc).mul (hη.comp continuous_snd))
  have hd := hasDerivAt_parameter_integral
    (G := fun t s => xCoord (angleVariation θ η t) 0 s * sin (θ s + t * η s) -
      yCoord (angleVariation θ η t) 0 s * cos (θ s + t * η s))
    (D := fun t s =>
      (∫ q in 0..s, -sin (θ q + t * η q) * η q) * sin (θ s + t * η s) +
        xCoord (angleVariation θ η t) 0 s * (cos (θ s + t * η s) * η s) -
      ((∫ q in 0..s, cos (θ q + t * η q) * η q) * cos (θ s + t * η s) +
        yCoord (angleVariation θ η t) 0 s * (-sin (θ s + t * η s) * η s)))
    ((hX.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp hc)).sub (hY.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp hc)))
    (((hU.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp hc)).add
      (hX.mul ((Real.continuous_cos.comp hc).mul (hη.comp continuous_snd)))).sub
      ((hV.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp hc)).add
        (hY.mul ((Real.continuous_sin.comp hc).neg.mul (hη.comp continuous_snd)))))
    (fun t s => by
      have ha : HasDerivAt (fun p => θ s + p * η s) (η s) t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (η s)).const_add (θ s)
      exact ((hasDerivAt_xCoord_variation hθ hη t s).mul ha.sin).sub
        ((hasDerivAt_yCoord_variation hθ hη t s).mul ha.cos)) ℓ 0
  have hzero : angleVariation θ η 0 = θ := by ext s; simp [angleVariation]
  have hh := hd.const_mul (1 / 2)
  rw [hzero] at hh
  simpa only [area, angleVariation, zero_mul, add_zero] using hh
records.comment: Differentiate the reconstructed area integral before removing its boundary term.

records.statement:
theorem area_variation_integral_eq {θ η : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    ((1 / 2) * ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
        (∫ q in 0..s, -sin (θ q) * η q) * sin (θ s) +
          xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s) -
        ((∫ q in 0..s, cos (θ q) * η q) * cos (θ s) +
          yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s))) =
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η s) -
      (xCoord θ 0 ℓ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η s) +
        yCoord θ 0 ℓ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s) * η s)) / 2
records.proof:
by
  let U := fun s => ∫ q in 0..s, -sin (θ q) * η q
  let V := fun s => ∫ q in 0..s, cos (θ q) * η q
  have hC := Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ
  have hS := Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ
  have hX : Continuous (xCoord θ 0) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ 0 s).continuousAt
  have hY : Continuous (yCoord θ 0) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ 0 s).continuousAt
  have hUd (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt U (-sin (θ s) * η s) s :=
    ((hS.neg.mul hη).integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 s).hasDerivAt
  have hVd (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt V (cos (θ s) * η s) s :=
    ((hC.mul hη).integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 s).hasDerivAt
  have hU : Continuous U := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hUd s).continuousAt
  have hV : Continuous V := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hVd s).continuousAt
  have hpartsU : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, U s * sin (θ s)) =
      U ℓ * yCoord θ 0 ℓ - (∫ s in 0..ℓ, yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s)) := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
      (fun s _ => hUd s) (fun s _ => hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ 0 s)
      ((hS.neg.mul hη).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) (hS.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
    simpa only [yCoord_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, mul_comm] using h
  have hpartsV : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, V s * cos (θ s)) =
      V ℓ * xCoord θ 0 ℓ - (∫ s in 0..ℓ, xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s)) := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
      (fun s _ => hVd s) (fun s _ => hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ 0 s)
      ((hC.mul hη).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) (hC.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
    simpa only [xCoord_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, mul_comm] using h
  have hmoment :
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η s) =
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s)) -
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s)) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (μ := volume)
      (f := fun s => xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s))
      (g := fun s => yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s))
      ((hX.mul (hC.mul hη)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
      ((hY.mul (hS.neg.mul hη)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    ring
  have hUne : U ℓ = -(∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s) * η s) := by
    simp only [U, neg_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
  change (1 / 2) * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, U s * sin (θ s) +
      xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s) -
      (V s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s))) = _
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (μ := volume)
    (f := fun s => U s * sin (θ s) + xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s))
    (g := fun s => V s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s))
    (((hU.mul hS).add (hX.mul (hC.mul hη))).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
    (((hV.mul hC).add (hY.mul (hS.neg.mul hη))).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ),
    intervalIntegral.integral_add (μ := volume)
      (f := fun s => U s * sin (θ s))
      (g := fun s => xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s))
      ((hU.mul hS).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
      ((hX.mul (hC.mul hη)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ),
    intervalIntegral.integral_add (μ := volume)
      (f := fun s => V s * cos (θ s))
      (g := fun s => yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s))
      ((hV.mul hC).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
      ((hY.mul (hS.neg.mul hη)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ),
    hpartsU, hpartsV, hmoment, hUne]
  dsimp [V]
  ring
records.comment: Integration by parts displays the endpoint contribution of the actual area derivative.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_area_variation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => area (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η s) -
      (xCoord θ 0 ℓ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η s) +
        yCoord θ 0 ℓ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s) * η s)) / 2) 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [← area_variation_integral_eq hθ hη ℓ]
  exact hasDerivAt_area_variation_raw hθ hη ℓ
records.comment: First variation of signed area with its explicit endpoint correction.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_area_variation_feasible {θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (_hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η)
    (hx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η s) = 0)
    (hy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => area (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η s) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hx' : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s) * η s) = 0 := by
    simpa only [neg_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_eq_zero] using hx
  simpa only [hy, hx', mul_zero, add_zero, zero_div, sub_zero] using
    hasDerivAt_area_variation hθ hη ℓ
records.comment: Endpoint-feasible directions cancel the complete boundary correction.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_firstIntegral_hasDerivAt
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k p lam μ s : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => k * (deriv θ t) ^ 2 / 2 -
      (lam - p * yCoord θ 0 t) * cos (θ t) -
      (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 t) * sin (θ t)) 0 s
records.proof:
by
  have ht := (hθ.differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt
  have hκ := ((hθ.deriv' (n := 2)).differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt
  have hX := hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ.continuous 0 s
  have hY := hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ.continuous 0 s
  have hmoment := (hκ.const_mul k).unique hAngle
  convert (((hκ.pow 2).const_mul k).div_const 2).sub
    (((hasDerivAt_const s lam).sub (hY.const_mul p)).mul ht.cos) |>.sub
      (((hasDerivAt_const s μ).add (hX.const_mul p)).mul ht.sin) using 1
  norm_num only [Nat.reduceSub, pow_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => q * deriv θ s) hmoment]
records.comment:
The force components are `(lam - p Y, mu + p X)`. Their tangent projection
has a quadratic-curvature first integral, derived from the angle equation.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_angleForce_hasDerivAt
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {p lam μ s : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t =>
      p * (xCoord θ 0 t * cos (θ t) + yCoord θ 0 t * sin (θ t)) -
        lam * sin (θ t) + μ * cos (θ t))
      (p - ((lam - p * yCoord θ 0 s) * cos (θ s) +
        (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 s) * sin (θ s)) * deriv θ s) s
records.proof:
by
  have ht := (hθ.differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt
  have hX := hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ.continuous 0 s
  have hY := hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ.continuous 0 s
  convert ((((hX.mul ht.cos).add (hY.mul ht.sin)).const_mul p).sub
    (ht.sin.const_mul lam)).add (ht.cos.const_mul μ) using 1
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => p * q) (sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ s))]
records.comment:
The pressure contribution to the differentiated moment equation is exactly
`p`, using unit arclength speed. The other term is the tangential force.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_angle_firstIntegral_curvature
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      (k * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / 2 -
        (lam - p * yCoord θ 0 s) * cos (θ s) -
        (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 s) * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = p)
records.proof:
by
  have hfirst : ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      k * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / 2 -
        (lam - p * yCoord θ 0 s) * cos (θ s) -
        (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 s) * sin (θ s) = σ := by
    apply isOpen_Ioo.exists_is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (convex_Ioo 0 ℓ).isPreconnected
    · intro s hs
      exact (pressure_firstIntegral_hasDerivAt hθ (hAngle s hs)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro s hs
      exact (pressure_firstIntegral_hasDerivAt hθ (hAngle s hs)).deriv
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hfirst
  refine ⟨σ, fun s hs => ⟨hσ s hs, ?_⟩⟩
  have hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv θ) := hθ.deriv' (n := 2)
  have heq : deriv (fun t => k * deriv θ t) =ᶠ[𝓝 s]
      (fun t => p * (xCoord θ 0 t * cos (θ t) + yCoord θ 0 t * sin (θ t)) -
        lam * sin (θ t) + μ * cos (θ t)) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with t ht
    exact (hAngle t ht).deriv
  have hsecond := ((pressure_angleForce_hasDerivAt (p := p) (lam := lam)
    (μ := μ) (s := s) hθ).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).deriv
  have hfun : deriv (fun t => k * deriv θ t) =
      (fun t => k * deriv (deriv θ) t) := by
    funext t
    exact ((hκ.differentiable (by norm_num) t).hasDerivAt.const_mul k).deriv
  rw [hfun, ((hκ.differentiable_deriv_two s).hasDerivAt.const_mul k).deriv] at hsecond
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => q * deriv θ s) (hσ s hs)]
records.comment:
The same constant in the force first integral yields the forced curvature
equation. The second derivative is obtained from the actual angle equation.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_angle_curvature
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
